Pluto follows one of the ants and, of course, he and later Donald become enmeshed in the fly paper

beached.title: Beached
beached.desc: The soundtrack begins with the artist stating the conditions: “An artist may construct a work and/or a work may be fabricated and/or a work need not be built. I elected five possibilities for videotape.” These possibilities are the actions executed in Beached. They are shot in five sequences and consist of throwing, pulling, lifting, dragging, and using leverage.

the-bead-game.title: The Bead Game
the-bead-game.desc: To a percussive soundtrack, a succession of more complex animals forms and is consumed by their successors (all formed from beads). Finally, We reach man, who develops ever more sophisticated forms of war.

bean-cake.title: Bean Cake
bean-cake.desc: On his first day of school in Tokyo 1933, young Uchida Taro makes the mistake of saying he likes his favourite snack more than the Emperor.

the-beaning.title: The Beaning
the-beaning.desc: An experimental documentary exploring a sinister theory surrounding the death of Cleveland baseball player Ray Chapman in 1920 and the subsequent rise of the Yankee dynasty.

beanstalk-bunny.title: Beanstalk Bunny
beanstalk-bunny.desc: Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck (as Jack) find themselves at the top of a beanstalk where they get chased around by a giant Elmer Fudd.

bear-2011.title: Bear
bear-2011.desc: Jack means well, but sometimes good intentions have horrible consequences.

bear-1993.title: Bear
bear-1993.desc: Bear (10 minutes, 35 seconds) was Steve McQueen's first major film. Although not an overtly political work, for many viewers it raises sensitive issues about race, homoeroticism and violence. It depicts two naked men – one of whom is the artist – tussling and teasing one another in an encounter which shifts between tenderness and aggression. The film is silent but a series of stares, glances and winks between the protagonists creates an optical language of flirtation and threat.

the-bear-dream.title: The Bear Dream
the-bear-dream.desc: (Fictional history): This film was made by in 1937 Arthur Rosenzweig, a member of the Coney Island Amateur Psychoanalytic Society. Here he recreates one of his dreams on film and analyzes it according to Freud's theories.

a-bear-for-punishment.title: A Bear for Punishment
a-bear-for-punishment.desc: Junyer Bear has a number of surprises for Good Ol' Pa on Good Ol' Father's Day, whether he wants them or not.

bear-story.title: Bear Story
bear-story.desc: An old bear goes out every day to a busy street corner. Through a tin marionette theater of his own making, the bear will tell us his life story.

the-bear-that-wasnt.title: The Bear That Wasn't
the-bear-that-wasnt.desc: A bear settles down for his long winter nap, and while he sleeps the progress of man continues. He wakes up to find himself in the middle of an industrial complex where nobody believes he's a bear.

the-bears-tale.title: The Bear's Tale
the-bears-tale.desc: The Three Bears meets Little Red Riding Hood, told in the style of Tex Avery.

bear-night-mare.title: Bear-Night-Mare
bear-night-mare.desc: A modern comedy fairy tale consisting of three comic and instructive short stories, united with one character - the Bear. The hero of the first short story – the beaver who dreams to fly like a bird. The second story is about the duck.
bear-night-mare.director: Vasily Kafanov, Aleksei Shelmanov, Aleksey Turkus

bearly-asleep.title: Bearly Asleep
bearly-asleep.desc: Park ranger Donald sends his bears off to hibernate, but Humphrey would rather stay in his hammock, run out for a glass of water, etc., than sleep; when he does get to sleep, his snoring gets him thrown out. His search for a new bed leads him right into the ranger's house.

the-bears-and-the-bees.title: The Bears and the Bees
the-bears-and-the-bees.desc: Two bear cubs tussle harmlessly, then start to munch on a berry bush, until a bigger, meaner bear chases them off. They nibble some flowers and find a bee, which they follow to the hive, which they then proceed to raid. The big bear chases them off, but unknown to him, a bee spotted the raid and has summoned the attack squad. The bees run him off, and the cubs dig in.

the-beast-2020-1.title: The Beast
the-beast-2020-1.desc: A young mexican smuggler and a little girl travel illegally on top of a cargo train, called La Bestia, to get to the USA. An injury transforms his perception of the journey.
the-beast-2020-1.director: Marlijn van Nuenen, Ram Tamez, Alfredo Gerard Kuttikatt

beat-2013.title: Beat
beat-2013.desc: A film about a man walking a paper-thin line between hopelessness and euphoria, testing and pushing the boundaries of conventions and impulse.

beat-the-devil-2002.title: Beat the Devil
beat-the-devil-2002.desc: The Driver drag-races the Devil, in order to earn James Brown his soul.

beatles-electroniques.title: Beatles Electroniques
beatles-electroniques.desc: Part of a collection of restored early works by Nam June Paik, the haunting Beatles Electronique reveals Paik's engagement with manipulation of pop icons and electronic images. Snippets of footage from the feature film A Hard Day's Night and the "Rain" promotional film are countered with Paik's early electronic processing.

beau.title: Beau
beau.desc: A neurotic middle-aged man's trip (to visit his mother) is delayed indefinitely when his keys are mysteriously taken from his door. He is subsequently haunted by an increasingly sinister chain of upsetting events.

the-beau-brummels.title: The Beau Brummels
the-beau-brummels.desc: Vaudeville team Shaw & Lee sing songs and tell jokes in hilarious deadpan.

the-beautiful-leukanida.title: The Beautiful Leukanida
the-beautiful-leukanida.desc: Two insects fight over the hand of a beautiful lady.

beautiful-movie.title: Beautiful Movie
beautiful-movie.desc: "Beautiful Movie" is a filmic cameo during which a passage of blue film leader and clear film painted red introduces a lovely image of a woman, naked from the waist up, sitting on a brass bed, combing her hair. When we first see the woman, she is well out of focus, but during the following minute or so she slowly becomes clear. As soon as the image is completely clear, however, Huot dissolves to an image of himself sitting in a similar position, combing his own hair. This image quickly goes out of focus, and the viewer sees the original passage of leader and painted film, this time in reverse, forming the other half of a filmic frame. "Beautiful Movie" is a quietly feminist work; Huot…

lovely-yellow-color.title: Lovely Yellow Color
lovely-yellow-color.desc: A story told in the off about the growing discomfort towards the new roommate Valentin. The camera pans through the empty room, over the shadows on the wall and the wallpaper, the yellow scarf and the postcard from Italy with the sunflowers

beauty-2014.title: Beauty
beauty-2014.desc: A short story of the most important emotions of life, from birth to death, love and sexuality through pain and fear. It is a tribute to art and his disarming beauty.

beauty-brothers.title: Beauty Brothers
beauty-brothers.desc: Presented in five vignettes, and starring the brothers of Matt Dillon. The Beauty Brothers offers-up the romance, desire, dreamscapes and frustrations of youth. Part I: Junk Food Conversation, 2:44; Part II: Bedroom Bongos, 2:37; Part III: Dream Wheels, 2:39; Part IV: Poolhopping, 1:47; Part V: Runaway, 2:39

beauty-juice.title: Beauty Juice
beauty-juice.desc: An innocent and impressionable girl, Sarah, gets an invitation to a secret beauty shop only to find it's not what she expects.

beauty-mark-2016.title: Beauty Mark
beauty-mark-2016.desc: A door-to door cosmetics saleswoman in 1986 finds a new customer.

the-beauty-of-excess.title: The Beauty of Excess
the-beauty-of-excess.desc: This animation can be watched in 2D or using Chromadepth Glasses in 3D.

bed-time.title: Bed Time
bed-time.desc: First, Max, in his pyjamas, gets back up and draws an isolated mountain area and puts Koko on top of a steep mountain. "That will keep you busy for the night," says the real-life somewhat nasty cartoonist to his subject. The cartoon really gets wild from that point with guest appearances from Mutt and Jeff, and other "stars" of the day as Koko experiences one adventure after another from the "Cave Of The Winds" to Goliath chasing him all over.

bedevilled-rabbit.title: Bedevilled Rabbit
bedevilled-rabbit.desc: Hidden in a box of carrots, Bugs lands in Tasmania, where he matches wits with the Tasmanian Devil.

bedfellows-2008.title: Bedfellows
bedfellows-2008.desc: When a woman is being called in the middle of the night, she finds out that it's not her husband laying next to her.

bedhead.title: Bedhead
bedhead.desc: David defaces his sister's doll. In the fight that follows Rebecca falls and hits her head. When she comes to, she discovers that she has telekinetic powers, and uses them to take revenge on her brother David.

bedtime-for-sniffles.title: Bedtime for Sniffles
bedtime-for-sniffles.desc: Christmas Eve, and Sniffles is determined to stay awake to see Santa. Not an easy task.

bedtime-for-the-bride.title: Bedtime for the Bride
bedtime-for-the-bride.desc: A newlywed couple in front of their wedding-bed after their wedding. The woman undresses in front of her husband. A French erotic short film considered to be one of the first erotic films made.

bee-at-the-beach.title: Bee at the Beach
bee-at-the-beach.desc: Donald cheerfully sets up his umbrella etcetera for a day at the beach, but so did a mischievously lazy bee, who doesn't accept his actions inadvertently mess up the bee's spot. Once Donald is in the water in an inflatable raft, the irate insect uses its angle to sting not the duck, but the dingy, more often then Donald has fingers and toes to stuff in the holes, next makes sure to attract the 'gastronomical' attention of a whole band of sharks: duck hunting season at sea is open. Donald uses all the resourcefulness of desperation, and his only weapon, the beach umbrella...

bee-on-guard.title: Bee On Guard
bee-on-guard.desc: Gardener Donald spots bees in his garden and follows them back to the hive in search of honey. The bee guarding the hive won't let him in, so Donald disguises himself as a bee.

beep-prepared.title: Beep Prepared
beep-prepared.desc: Wile E. Coyote tries yet again to catch the Road Runner.

beep-beep.title: Beep, Beep
beep-beep.desc: The Coyote chases the Road Runner through a maze of mine shafts.

beezy-bear.title: Beezy Bear
beezy-bear.desc: Beekeeper Donald catches Humphrey the bear raiding his hives. He complains to Ranger Woodlore, who assembles his bears and lectures them. Donald puts up a barbed wire fence, which slows Humphrey down a bit, but doesn't stop him.

before-before.title: Before Before
before-before.desc: This animation can be watched in 2D or using Chromadepth Glasses in 3D.

before-dawn.title: Before Dawn
before-dawn.desc: Before Dawn has a single shot which is several minutes in length. Technically this is immaculate, visually it is stunning. The story is set in a field; where the field is we don't know, but a lone truck drives up into the field and stops. A horn beeps and from beneath the long grass thirty of so people appear and proceed to enter the truck. We take it they hiding from something and this is their doorway. The truck leaves, but only to be greeted by a mass of police and even a helicopter blocking their path.

before-sunrise-2005.title: Before Sunrise
before-sunrise-2005.desc: It's 4 a.m. in a European village. Small shadows are at mischievous play. One of their number stands apart, melancholy. He climbs to a rooftop in the moonlight and sees one window lit. He investigates. An old man dozes and a candle burns by the window. The flame smiles at him. He tries to touch her and is singed. Is this the end of the encounter or can metaphysics and desire work a small miracle?

before-the-gates.title: Before the Gates
before-the-gates.desc: Trite, closed memories flagrantly bleed into profuse openings mixed & held together by retaliatory colorations & obfuscations.

before-vanishing.title: Before Vanishing
before-vanishing.desc: The Barada, the river around which the city of Damascus was built, is drying up. The film follows his journey through the city, its neighborhoods, its inhabitants, its noises and its smells.

beginners-luck-2014.title: Beginner's Luck
beginners-luck-2014.desc: A team of strangers goes all the way to the championship and takes on the perennial champs, in this tale of a small town bowling league changing people's lives.

beginning.title: Beginning
beginning.desc: Philosophical essay about the October Revolution of 1917 in Russia, its influence on the destiny of the world in the 20th century.

the-beginning-the-middle.title: The Beginning & the Middle
the-beginning-the-middle.desc: Two childhood best friends are reunited at a house party and debate the pros and cons of finally hooking up.

beginning-of-the-serpentine-dance.title: Beginning of the Serpentine Dance
beginning-of-the-serpentine-dance.desc: In a living room, four contemporary couples from the time the film was shot dance a waltz under the direction of a violinist (Linder). They begin a minuet and their costumes change in a sudden. A man enters and seems interested in what he sees, casts a spell and everything disappears. Transforming himself into the devil, the visitor takes the violinist with him to hell, where he creates a large piece of silk out of a cauldron. The fabric unrolls, revealing a young woman in a silk dress that starts dancing the serpentine. While she dances, other women join in a synchronized ballet, before all of them vanish into bursts of flames.

beginnings.title: Beginnings
beginnings.desc: An animated film created from pastel drawings by Clorinda Warny, Premiers Jours traces the complete cycle of life, from birth to adulthood, in four seasons, and through the evolution of earthly landscapes that become human bodies. Completed Postumously by Suzanne Gervais, Lina Gagnon
beginnings.director: Lina Gagnon, Suzanne Gervais, Clorinda Warny

the-beguiled-the-storyteller.title: The Beguiled: The Storyteller
the-beguiled-the-storyteller.desc: The Beguiled: The Storyteller is the first documentary short ever directed by Clint Eastwood. Shot in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, under the Malpaso Production Company, it has a running time of 12 minutes and provides a behind-the-scenes look at the making of the 1971 film, The Beguiled. Eastwood highlights each of the primary actors including himself as well as director Don Siegel.

behind.title: Behind
behind.desc: A divorced mother is obsessed with the idea that her ex-husband is plotting to take her baby away from her.

behind-closed-doors-2009.title: Behind Closed Doors
behind-closed-doors-2009.desc: Troubled by his conflicting parents and haunted by the monster that dwells in his bedroom closet - Gregory must confront his demons and defeat the true evil that exists behind closed doors.

behind-every-good-man.title: Behind Every Good Man
behind-every-good-man.desc: Behind Every Good Man provides a glimpse into the life of an African American transgender woman in 1960s Los Angeles.

behind-the-lines.title: Behind the Lines
behind-the-lines.desc: Elsie Janis entertains the troops from the back of a truck. She calls a French soldier up to sing with her, then dances to an American song while everyone sings, and finally shares the stage with an English soldier.

behind-the-scenes-1975.title: Behind the Scenes
behind-the-scenes-1975.desc: "This mysterious, delightful film opens with a sound collage of jazzy music and voices played against a black background. After a few minutes, there is an extended shot of a young woman sitting at a table by a window with a slight look of embarrassment as she tries to keep a straight face under the camera’s gaze. Made just after Shift, it continues Gehr’s early experiments with sound editing. It is startling in the context of his other work as his first film with a straight on close shot of a person." – David Schwartz

behind-this-soft-eclipse.title: Behind This Soft Eclipse
behind-this-soft-eclipse.desc: A crossing of paths behind the seen, a labor of love in the wake of one who was just here.

behind-your-walls.title: Behind Your Walls
behind-your-walls.desc: Frans Zwartjes' two visions of womanhood in Behind Your Walls have all the febrile frustration associated with his previous work. Flesh looks like crisp paper about to be despoiled, a torpid heat reduces movement to fidgets and hesitations. - MIFF

the-beholder.title: The Beholder
the-beholder.desc: On a city street, a man rants about god, the devil and repentance. Nearby, people sit in a crowded restaurant. Detached from those around them, they eat, mumble and fantasize without any passion or engagement. A waitress apathetic recites the specials. Two men literally pass through each other near the toilets. These people have shelter and food, but they aren't alive. The restaurant almost becomes a security blanket, a place to hide from their crazy, mundane and trapped existence. The mad street preacher is a lone voice of conviction and delusion.

beijing-1988.title: Beijing 1988
beijing-1988.desc: China seen from Beijing May 1988, a year before the Spring 1989 Tiananmen rebellion, where the ancient traditional philosophies and social practices confront the political and economical ideological ambitions of the State.

being-flat.title: Being Flat
being-flat.desc: Puppets and electro take center stage as director Quentin Dupieux, AKA Mr. Oizo, resurrects his Flat Eric character for this awkward comedy.

being-pretty.title: Being Pretty
being-pretty.desc: Hello, citizens of Autodale! You are pretty. Your neighbours, friends and family are also pretty. But sadly, not everyone is pretty. Some are ugly… We, here at Autodale, do not want “uglies”.

beirut-outtakes.title: Beirut Outtakes
beirut-outtakes.desc: Fragments from movies found in an abandoned cinema in Beirut. Retrieved by Mr. Salloum. Assembled by Ms. Ahwesh.

belials-dream.title: Belial's Dream
belials-dream.desc: In this continuation of the Basket Case saga, Belial has a rather unsavoury dream…

belladonna-1989.title: Belladonna
belladonna-1989.desc: An experimental short by Beth B. It consists of rapidly intercut close-ups of talking heads reading statements from a Sigmund Freud case history; affidavits attesting to the atrocities of Dr. Josef Mengele, the Nazi war criminal; and journals from the trial of New Yorker Joel Steinberg, accused of killing his adopted daughter.

bellboy-donald.title: Bellboy Donald
bellboy-donald.desc: Donald tries his best to be polite and dignified as a hotel bellboy. But when his first guest is Pete Junior, the job is next to impossible.

belle-river.title: Belle River
belle-river.desc: In 2019 Mississippi spring flooding hits record highs. Residents of Pierre-Part, Louisiana, prepare for the worst, as authorities are expected to open the floodgates of the Morganza Spillway to save the cities of New Orleans and Bâton Rouge from flooding. Faith and resilience are their only defense.
belle-river.director: Guillaume Fournier, Samuel Matteau, Yannick Nolin

bells-of-atlantis.title: Bells of Atlantis
bells-of-atlantis.desc: A perfect fusion of poetry and film, with dense layered imagery and music from electro pioneers Louise and Bebe Barron. The writer Anaïs Nin provides dialogue from her novella “House of Incest” and appears adrift in the undersea realm of Atlantis before ascending to dry land.

belly-2012.title: Belly
belly-2012.desc: Oscar is coming of age, against his better judgment. In doing so he must experience the necessary evil of leaving something behind, but he can still feel it in the pit of his stomach.

ben-boyer-and-the-phenomenology-of-autom.title: Ben Boyer and the Phenomenology of Automobile Marketing
ben-boyer-and-the-phenomenology-of-autom.desc: While sitting on the toilet one November morning, Ben Boyer receives a Jungian lesson on archetypal marketing.

ben-hur-1907.title: Ben Hur
ben-hur-1907.desc: The first adaptation of Lew Wallace's novel, Ben-Hur: A Tale of the Christ.

beneath-the-skin-1981.title: Beneath the Skin
beneath-the-skin-1981.desc: "Relating a tale told by a girl on a swing, Beneath the Skin explores the contrast between the impersonal horror of a news story heard on television and the involvement of the storyteller in a nightmare, which gradually becomes more familiar and commonplace as the tale unfolds. The straightforward approach of the teller is humorously or frighteningly contrasted by a bombardment of visual images which mock or intensify the macabre flavor of the work."

benigni.title: Benigni
benigni.desc: A man lives alone in a block of flats. He may not be able to put a finger on it, but he is lonely. All this changes, though, when the odd growth he has been ignoring on his side turns out to be something alive and becomes conscious.
benigni.director: Elli Vuorinen, Jasmiini Ottelin, Pinja Partanen

libido-of-benjamino.title: Libido of Benjamino
libido-of-benjamino.desc: A surreal film with a Freudian theme.

berlin-blue.title: Berlin Blue
berlin-blue.desc: "A little celebration of shades of blue and Berlin. The film was hand-processed and then toned blue in a bucket. With love and thanks to East Street Arts – most of this film was shot in Berlin while on an ESA Christmas art trip!" — M.J.

berlin-horse.title: Berlin Horse
berlin-horse.desc: Two fragments of 8mm home-movie footage shot by the artist near Berlin weave together in repeating cycles of action, temporal manipulation, and colour distortion, heightening the viewer’s awareness of film-time and the film-image, and perception of colour in motion.

berlin-troika.title: Berlin Troika
berlin-troika.desc: During a stormy night of grave political crisis, an expert interpreter suffers a nervous breakdown. Young diplomat Konrad Gelb is recruited to step in and interpret between the two conflicting superpower leaders, who seem to hold the fate of humanity in their hands - an absurd responsibility, which by extension rests on the shoulders of the young interpreter. He must balance the oversized egos in the room and maneuver the world's destiny to either peaceful resolution or total annihilation.

bernado-de-pace.title: Bernado De Pace
bernado-de-pace.desc: Bernardo De Pace, known as "The Wizard of the Mandolin," plays several tunes, including "Morning, Noon and Night in Vienna" and "That's Why I Love You."

best-friend-2018.title: Best Friend
best-friend-2018.desc: In a near future, a lonely man is addicted to a product called ‘’Best Friend” which offers him perfect virtual friends.
best-friend-2018.director: Shen Yi, Juliana De Lucca, Nicholas Olivieri, Varun Nair, David Feliu

the-best-men.title: The Best Men
the-best-men.desc: Moments before his best friend's wedding, Peter gets one last chance to rekindle mutual feelings long suppressed, but not abandoned. Sometimes the perfect reminder of first love's passion is but a simple kiss from the best man. The Best Men explores a universal heartache that every individual has experienced - the feeling of having missed out on true love.

best-of-luck-with-the-wall.title: Best of Luck with the Wall
best-of-luck-with-the-wall.desc: A video directed by Josh Begley shows the preposterous effort that would be required to build a border wall.

bestiary-or-the-parade-of-orpheus.title: Bestiary, or the Parade of Orpheus
bestiary-or-the-parade-of-orpheus.desc: One of the adventures of João de Deus.

beasts-1993.title: Beasts
beasts-1993.desc: Short animated Hungarian film. Based on works of Hungarian avant-garde artists: Wahorn András, fe Lugossy László, and ef Zámbó István.

bethlehem-2009.title: Bethlehem
bethlehem-2009.desc: Writes Ahwesh: "Working through my archive of accumulated video footage, I pretended it was found footage from anonymous sources. What began as a tribute to Bruce Conner of the period of Valse Triste and Take the 5:10 to Dreamland, with their deliberate pace and bittersweet memory of home, ended as a dedication to my father as I wound my way through miscellany with distance and another aim."

better-things-2016.title: Better Things
better-things-2016.desc: A boy at the cusp of his high school graduation envisions his future.

betty-boop-and-grampy.title: Betty Boop and Grampy
betty-boop-and-grampy.desc: Betty Boop and some friends go to Grampy's house for a party.

betty-boop-and-little-jimmy.title: Betty Boop and Little Jimmy
betty-boop-and-little-jimmy.desc: Betty tries a regime of exercise, but her weight loss gets out of hand. She sings "Keep Your Girlish Figure".

betty-boop-and-the-little-king.title: Betty Boop and the Little King
betty-boop-and-the-little-king.desc: Betty encounters The Little King when, bored by the opera, he sneaks out to join in with her rodeo routine.

betty-boop-for-president.title: Betty Boop for President
betty-boop-for-president.desc: Betty's campaign tries to appeal to everyone. Real candidates are parodied, but campaign promises are a bit bizarre.

the-betty-boop-limited.title: The Betty Boop Limited
the-betty-boop-limited.desc: On a special train, Betty's show troupe rehearses: Betty sings, Bimbo juggles, and Koko does a soft-shoe. The train itself also does tricks.

betty-boops-bamboo-isle.title: Betty Boop's Bamboo Isle
betty-boops-bamboo-isle.desc: On a South Sea isle, Bimbo meets Betty in the guise of a hula dancer.

betty-boops-big-boss.title: Betty Boop's Big Boss
betty-boops-big-boss.desc: Betty takes a secretarial job where the boss sexually harasses her… but not without some encouragement from Betty.

betty-boops-birthday-party.title: Betty Boop's Birthday Party
betty-boops-birthday-party.desc: Betty drudges in the kitchen alone until her friends (including Bimbo and Koko) hold a surprise birthday party for her… which gets rowdy.

betty-boops-bizzy-bee.title: Betty Boop's Bizzy Bee
betty-boops-bizzy-bee.desc: Everyone loves the wheat cakes served by short-order cook Betty, but they have a drawback. With Bimbo and Koko; no bee is involved.

betty-boops-crazy-inventions.title: Betty Boop's Crazy Inventions
betty-boops-crazy-inventions.desc: In a circus tent, Betty, Bimbo and Koko demonstrate some gadgets reminiscent of TV ads; an animated sewing machine gets out of hand.

betty-boops-halloween-party.title: Betty Boop's Hallowe'en Party
betty-boops-halloween-party.desc: Betty Boop hosts a Hallowe'en party with a few uninvited guests.

betty-boops-ker-choo.title: Betty Boop's Ker-Choo
betty-boops-ker-choo.desc: Betty, Koko, and Bimbo drive at the auto races; Betty has a cold, and her sneezes help her win.

betty-boops-life-guard.title: Betty Boop's Life Guard
betty-boops-life-guard.desc: Betty takes a trip to the beach and needs the assistance of a big, hunky lifeguard when she rides her rubber horsy out too far!

betty-boops-may-party.title: Betty Boop's May Party
betty-boops-may-party.desc: Betty and Bimbo, as Queen and King of the May, host a giant outdoor party that gets sprayed with rubber. Koko appears briefly.

betty-boops-museum.title: Betty Boop's Museum
betty-boops-museum.desc: Koko is recruiting customers for a 50 cent sightseeing tour of the museum. Betty is Koko's only passenger. Betty gets locked inside by accident. The skeletons from the displays come to life and chase Betty, until she is finally rescued by Bimbo.

betty-boops-penthouse.title: Betty Boop's Penthouse
betty-boops-penthouse.desc: While Bimbo and Koko admire Betty, their experiment becomes a monster.

betty-boops-rise-to-fame.title: Betty Boop's Rise to Fame
betty-boops-rise-to-fame.desc: A reporter interviews Max Fleischer about his creation, and Betty illustrates with excerpts from three prior cartoons.

betty-boops-trial.title: Betty Boop's Trial
betty-boops-trial.desc: A traffic cop tries to make time with Betty; she speeds to get away, is arrested, and undergoes a musical trial.

betty-boops-ups-and-downs.title: Betty Boop's Ups and Downs
betty-boops-ups-and-downs.desc: Due to the great depression, property prices start falling. The planet Earth goes up for sale. Mars and Venus make bids, but Saturn, characterised as an old Jew, makes a lower but winning bid. Then just to see what happens, he removes the earth's magnet, and gravity disappears.

betty-boop-md.title: Betty Boop, M.D.
betty-boop-md.desc: Betty, Koko and Bimbo sell a weird concoction in their medicine show.

betty-in-blunderland.title: Betty in Blunderland
betty-in-blunderland.desc: Betty falls asleep doing a jigsaw puzzle and finds herself through the looking glass into a modern, urban wonderland. The shrinking potion comes from a "Shrinkola" dispenser. When most of the characters assemble, Betty sings "How Do You Do" to them. But the jabberwock steals Betty away.

bettys-corner-cafe.title: Betty's Corner Cafe
bettys-corner-cafe.desc: This short tells the story of a cafe where steel workers come to eat.

between-bears.title: Between Bears
between-bears.desc: A tale of a pack who set out on a journey following a black bear.

between-calais-and-dover.title: Between Calais and Dover
between-calais-and-dover.desc: A rocky sea voyage as reenacted by Georges Méliès.

between-relating-and-use.title: Between Relating and Use
between-relating-and-use.desc: Borrowing words from Laura Mark's 'Transnational Object' and DW Winnicott's 'Transitional Object', all carefully etched into the 16mm film surface, Nazli Dinçel's latest work Between Relating and Use is an attempt to work ethically in a foreign land. Transitioning from assuming the position of an ethnographer, we turn and explore inwards – on how we use our lovers.

between-showers.title: Between Showers
between-showers.desc: Mr. Snookie steals an umbrella and then, while trying to help a woman to cross a puddle, the Tramp appears and intervenes.

beuys.title: Beuys
beuys.desc: The German artist Joseph Beuys is reflecting on his theory of art, being filmed as a kinetic sculpture. In 1981, the film has won the German film critic's award for “Best short film in Germany”.

beware-of-barnacle-bill.title: Beware of Barnacle Bill
beware-of-barnacle-bill.desc: To the classic tune of "Barnacle Bill the Sailor", Olive explains that she can't marry Popeye because she's in love with Barnacle Bill (an unusually large Bluto), who then comes by and proceeds to pound Popeye (until he eats his spinach, of course).

bewitched-bunny.title: Bewitched Bunny
bewitched-bunny.desc: Bugs must rescue Hansel and Gretel from Witch Hazel's clutches.

the-bewitched-inn.title: The Bewitched Inn
the-bewitched-inn.desc: A weary traveler stops at an inn along the way to get a good night's sleep, but his rest is interrupted by odd happenings when he gets to his room--beds vanishing and re-appearing, candles exploding, pants flying through the air and his shoes walking away by themselves.

beyond.title: Beyond
beyond.desc: While looking for her cat, a young woman and some kids find an abandoned building where strange things happen and the rules of physics don't always apply. Part of the Animatrix collection of animated shorts set in the Matrix universe.

beyond-enchantment.title: Beyond Enchantment
beyond-enchantment.desc: Where all is static motion; where music and light become one; where change and motion become one; and where the end is the beginning. Black and white cut-out animation with touches of color. Ladies of the past encounter science and natural phenomena.

beyond-noh.title: Beyond Noh
beyond-noh.desc: "Beyond Noh" rhythmically animates 3,475 individual masks from all over the world, beginning with the distinctive masks of the Japanese Noh theater and continuing on a cultural journey through ritual, utility, deviance, and politics.

beyond-nothing.title: Beyond Nothing
beyond-nothing.desc: A resolute man unapologetically abandons his first-born, believing that it was the right thing to do. Many years later, an inquisitive documentary filmmaker interrogates him.

beyond-picasso.title: Beyond Picasso
beyond-picasso.desc: Schwartz reordered and combined angular contours, broken planes, and distorted proportions in her own pictorial structures in an homage to Picasso's style.

beyond-the-night.title: Beyond the Night
beyond-the-night.desc: Hanoi 2003. A woman does her hair at night. A train passes between the houses. A crowd rushes by jostling, working. A forgotten child waits.

bff-girls.title: BFF Girls
bff-girls.desc: Three dorky American girls magically transform into beautiful Japanese Superheroes and fight a tampon monster as they begin their journey into womanhood.

bhakti-2018.title: Bhakti
bhakti-2018.desc: Baca captures the Ratha Yatra festivals in Buenos Aires between 1999 and 2004.

bicycle-1975.title: Bicycle
bicycle-1975.desc: Spokes-eye view of a bicycle ride.

bicyclist.title: Bicyclist
bicyclist.desc: Francis Doublier does bicycle tricks in the street.

bidoofs-big-stand.title: Bidoof's Big Stand
bidoofs-big-stand.desc: A bumbling Bidoof with a tendency to bite off more than it can chew finds itself between a rock and a hard place as it embarks on a journey to find its place in the world.

the-big-bad-wolf.title: The Big Bad Wolf
the-big-bad-wolf.desc: The Big Bad Wolf torments Little Red Riding Hood and the Three Little Pigs.

big-bang-1990.title: Big Bang
big-bang-1990.desc: Planet Earth has become a gigantic landfill, as a gardener and her husband learn too late.

big-bang-2022.title: Big Bang
big-bang-2022.desc: In Uberlândia in Brazil, Chico earns his living by repairing ovens, in which he enters easily thanks to his small size. Faced with the contempt of a system that relegates him to the ranks of the marginalized, he gradually enters into resistance.

big-bang-big-boom.title: Big Bang Big Boom
big-bang-big-boom.desc: Bold and innovative animation takes drawing into the real world.

big-buck-bunny.title: Big Buck Bunny
big-buck-bunny.desc: Follow a day of the life of Big Buck Bunny when he meets three bullying rodents: Frank, Rinky, and Gamera. The rodents amuse themselves by harassing helpless creatures by throwing fruits, nuts and rocks at them. After the deaths of two of Bunny's favorite butterflies, and an offensive attack on Bunny himself, Bunny sets aside his gentle nature and orchestrates a complex plan for revenge.

big-chief-ugh-amugh-ugh.title: Big Chief Ugh-Amugh-Ugh
big-chief-ugh-amugh-ugh.desc: Big Chief Ugh-Amugh-Ugh is looking for a squaw. Meanwhile, Popeye and Olive are wrestling with their recalcitrant mule and Olive accidentally lands in the Indian camp. Popeye catches up to her. There's an unfair fight, and Popeye is about to be burned at the stake. He drops his spinach, but it cooks and pops into his mouth.

big-heel-watha.title: Big Heel-Watha
big-heel-watha.desc: To prove he's a true Indian Brave, Big Heel-Watha decides to catch a squirrel - but wouldn't you know it; Screwy Squirrel is the first one he sees...

big-house-blues.title: Big House Blues
big-house-blues.desc: Ren and Stimpy, on the streets starving, are captured by the dog catcher. They end up in the pound and become frightened when one of the dogs tells them of the "big sleep".

big-house-bunny.title: Big House Bunny
big-house-bunny.desc: While attempting to evade a group of hunters, Bugs Bunny jumps into a rabbit hole and inadvertently tunnels into Sing Song prison, where the malevolent prison guard, Sam Schultz, assumes he's an inmate.

the-big-idea-1917.title: The Big Idea
the-big-idea-1917.desc: A clerk in a failing antiques store gets a big idea on how to move the merchandise so that he can save the store and possibly win the girl.

big-mouth.title: Big Mouth
big-mouth.desc: This animated short tells the story of Trudy, a little girl who is equal parts truthful and rude. A bright-minded and quick-witted child, Trudy has an unfiltered and deeply curious way of looking at the world. Here, events force her to question what it means to speak the truth, and comes to understand how our differences make us unique.

the-big-picture-2000.title: The Big Picture
the-big-picture-2000.desc: Consumed by her career, Wendy never imagined going out with Jack. She never imagined spending any time with him at all, but she's about to witness events that will change her mind. She's about to experience her life played out before her very eyes.

big-red-riding-hood.title: Big Red Riding Hood
big-red-riding-hood.desc: Jimmy Jump is asked by the Swedish Government to translate for educational purposes "Little Red Riding Hood", but he can't afford to buy the book, so he tries reading it at the book shop, something the owner doesn't like. But with a little help by the owner's wife it is not impossible, even when the book is bought by somebody else, put in a car and the car is stolen...

the-big-shave.title: The Big Shave
the-big-shave.desc: A young man walks into a meticulously clean and sterile bathroom and proceeds to shave away hair, then skin, in an increasingly bloody and graphic bathroom scene.

the-big-snit.title: The Big Snit
the-big-snit.desc: A couple has a fight over a game of Scrabble unaware that a full-scale nuclear war has started.

the-big-snooze.title: The Big Snooze
the-big-snooze.desc: Elmer Fudd walks out of a typical Bugs cartoon, so Bugs gets back at him by disturbing Elmer's sleep using "nightmare paint."

the-big-stick-an-old-reel.title: The Big Stick / An Old Reel
the-big-stick-an-old-reel.desc: Saul Levine spent six years (from 1967-1973) cutting up and re-editing 8mm prints of two Charlie Chaplin shorts, IN THE PARK and EASY STREET, into a dynamic yet dreamy deconstruction of physical and narrative movement. What begins with Chaplin looping around in circular repetitions between a cop and an ominous vagrant becomes more fractured as the film expands. News footage of police arresting protesters (shot from a television screen on black-and-white 8mm film) is cut into the comedy of cops and criminals (a shot of political reality amidst slapstick fantasy) and images are abstracted by rapid-fire cutting. Even the physical cuts on the celluloid become part of the image as Levine chops…

the-big-story.title: The Big Story
the-big-story.desc: In a witty homage to Kirk Douglas's films, all three characters ARE Kirk Douglas at various stages of his career. The short action takes place in a news room. A young reporter looking for his big chance pleads with his editor to give him a breaking story.

big-sur-the-ladies.title: Big Sur: The Ladies
big-sur-the-ladies.desc: Against the coastline of the Big Sur country the camera catches swiftly shifting fragments of the nude women at the baths, playing the guitar, cutting the hair, sleeping. The camera movement is used to slightly smear the images onto the film emulsion in a manner parallel with the use of broad different medium from music or painting.

big-top-bunny.title: Big Top Bunny
big-top-bunny.desc: Bugs Bunny is hired to perform in Colonel Korny's Circus alongside Bruno the Magnificent, the Slobokian Acrobatic Bear, but Bruno doesn't want to share the limelight.

the-big-wash.title: The Big Wash
the-big-wash.desc: Goofy tries his hand at a big job in the circus: feeding and washing the elephant.

big-wrench.title: Big Wrench
big-wrench.desc: In this narrative performance for video, Burden tells the story of his relationship with a truck named "Big Job." To relate his autobiographical monologue, he sits deadpan before the camera with moving images of the truck behind him. Writes Burden, "During a six-month period, while the artist wrestles with the problem of owning an antique 16,000 lb. freight-truck, Big Job becomes a metaphor for personal insanity. I talk about the 'curse of Big Job,' my foiled plans to transform the truck into a rolling communications command post or a traveling museum, and my difficulty in getting rid of the rig. A true story."

the-bigger-picture.title: The Bigger Picture
the-bigger-picture.desc: 'You want to put her in a home; you tell her; tell her now!' hisses one brother to the other. But Mother won't go, and their own lives quickly unravel as she clings to life. Director Daisy Jacobs uses two-metre-high painted characters in full-size sets to tell the stark and darkly humorous tale of caring for an elderly relative. The Bigger Picture is quite simply the most innovative animated short you will see this year.

biglove.title: BigLove
biglove.desc: When Samson and Delilah pack up for school like dutiful children, Mom and Dad employ their own adolescent diversions to try to keep them at home. A whimsical role-reversal story with enough love to go around.

bilby.title: Bilby
bilby.desc: Threatened daily by the deadly residents and harsh environment of Australia’s Outback, a lonesome bilby finds himself an unwitting protector, and unexpected friend, to a helpless (and quite adorable) baby bird.
bilby.director: JP Sans, Liron Topaz, Pierre Perifel

bill-and-tony.title: Bill and Tony
bill-and-tony.desc: Experimental film by William S. Burroughs and Antony Balch

bill-of-hare.title: Bill of Hare
bill-of-hare.desc: The Tasmanian Devil finds Bugs cooking dinner underneath a beach boardwalk.

billabong.title: Billabong
billabong.desc: A wordless impressionistic 'documentary' about a boys' camp.

billboard-frolics.title: Billboard Frolics
billboard-frolics.desc: Billboards come to life. Eddie Camphor and his "wioleen" player Rub-Him-Off do a song and dance to "Merrily We Roll Along" with new lyrics...

billion-dollar-limited.title: Billion Dollar Limited
billion-dollar-limited.desc: Robbers target a special train carrying a billion dollars worth of gold, and the only one who can stop them is Superman!

billposters.title: Billposters
billposters.desc: Donald and Goofy are putting up advertising posters in a farm. Goofy prepares to post on a windmill, but his tools keep disappearing and reappearing on the windmill blades. Donald puts up his posters, a picture of a soup can, and a goat eats them immediately. Goofy gets stuck to his poster after it comes around on the windmill. Donald, being his calm, even-tempered self, gets into a battle with the goat.

billy-2019.title: Billy
billy-2019.desc: In Zachary Epcar's fragmentary, soap opera-esque film, lounge music, lamps, coffee pods, and other accoutrements of modern life restage a story of domestic dreams and nightmares.

billy-and-mandy-in-trepanation-of-the-sk.title: Billy and Mandy in: Trepanation of the Skull and You
billy-and-mandy-in-trepanation-of-the-sk.desc: Maxwell Atoms' debut short has his characters Billy and Mandy having fun with trepanation.

billy-blazes-esq.title: Billy Blazes, Esq.
billy-blazes-esq.desc: Billy Blazes confronts Crooked Charley, who has been ruling the town of Peaceful Vale through fear and violence.

billy-boy.title: Billy Boy
billy-boy.desc: A deep south farmer is initially delighted to get a baby goat, but this soon turns to apprehension when he discovers that it eats literally anything (including, at one point, the animation artwork).

billy-edwards-and-the-unknown.title: Billy Edwards and the Unknown
billy-edwards-and-the-unknown.desc: Former lightweight boxer Billy Edwards, now a trainer and writer of the sport, takes on a challenger named Warwick in an exhibition match. The match is scheduled for five rounds of 20 seconds each. A large crowd has gathered behind the ring to watch the fight.

billy-sings-amazing-grace.title: Billy Sings Amazing Grace
billy-sings-amazing-grace.desc: High-definition video art from Theaster Gates

billys-dad-is-a-fudge-packer.title: Billy's Dad Is a Fudge-Packer
billys-dad-is-a-fudge-packer.desc: In this, her first non acting effort, writer/director Jamie Donahue parodies the 1950's high school educational film.

bimbos-express.title: Bimbo's Express
bimbos-express.desc: Betty Boop (with dog's ears) is moving; Bimbo comes with his moving van and is smitten with her. Songs: "Moving Day," "Hello Beautiful."

bimbos-initiation.title: Bimbo's Initiation
bimbos-initiation.desc: Bimbo finds himself surrounded by a mysterious group of robed figures who invite him to become a member of their secret organisation. When he refuses, they fling him through a nightmarish sequence of terror and torture devices. Will our hapless hero make it out alive?

bingo-1998.title: Bingo
bingo-1998.desc: A wildly surrealistic computer-generated animation in which a young man is psychologically brutalized by circus characters into believing he is a clown.

bingo-ninths.title: Bingo/Ninths
bingo-ninths.desc: In August 1974 Matta-Clark carried out a ‘cutting’ in a house at Niagara Falls, New York. The artist divided the north façade into nine parts. In the film you hear him ask the builders to postpone the demolition. Hence the word play Bingo/Ninths, which became beagone by ninth. The house was demolished an hour after he had finished. The segments were transported to Art Park, where some of them were dumped to be gradually swept away by the Niagara River.

binky-nelson-unpacified.title: Binky Nelson Unpacified
binky-nelson-unpacified.desc: After a daring heist at a museum, the youngest member of the villainous Nelson family, Binky, realizes he's left behind his beloved pacifier. Determined to retrieve it, Binky embarks on an adorable and hilarious mission to recover his prized possession.

bio-cop.title: Bio-Cop
bio-cop.desc: A mutated cop deals with existential despair while running down drug dealers.

biomes-i.title: Biomes I
biomes-i.desc: Biomes is a series of 4 paintings in motion inspired by the the surrealist landscapes of Tanguy and Kay Sage. Digital and analog video techniques are used to simulate painterly effects in an interplay between soft, harsh, mat and shiny surfaces, different shades of light and the illusion of depth or flatness. Biomes are portraits of post human environments where uncanny life forms materialize and slowly detach themselves from the horizon, to finally melt into their respective landscapes.

biomes-ii.title: Biomes II
biomes-ii.desc: Biomes is a series of 4 paintings in motion inspired by the the surrealist landscapes of Tanguy and Kay Sage. Digital and analog video techniques are used to simulate painterly effects in an interplay between soft, harsh, mat and shiny surfaces, different shades of light and the illusion of depth or flatness. Biomes are portraits of post human environments where uncanny life forms materialize and slowly detach themselves from the horizon, to finally melt into their respective landscapes.

biomes-iii.title: Biomes III
biomes-iii.desc: Biomes is a series of 4 paintings in motion inspired by the the surrealist landscapes of Tanguy and Kay Sage. Digital and analog video techniques are used to simulate painterly effects in an interplay between soft, harsh, mat and shiny surfaces, different shades of light and the illusion of depth or flatness. Biomes are portraits of post human environments where uncanny life forms materialize and slowly detach themselves from the horizon, to finally melt into their respective landscapes.

biomes-iv.title: Biomes IV
biomes-iv.desc: Biomes is a series of 4 paintings in motion inspired by the the surrealist landscapes of Tanguy and Kay Sage. Digital and analog video techniques are used to simulate painterly effects in an interplay between soft, harsh, mat and shiny surfaces, different shades of light and the illusion of depth or flatness. Biomes are portraits of post human environments where uncanny life forms materialize and slowly detach themselves from the horizon, to finally melt into their respective landscapes.

the-birch.title: The Birch
the-birch.desc: A bullied schoolboy takes drastic measures against his tormenter, summoning an ancient being in the woods using a spellbound book passed down through the generations of his family.

the-bird-the-whale.title: The Bird & The Whale
the-bird-the-whale.desc: A baby whale separated from his family discovers a caged bird, the sole survivor of a shipwreck. Together they struggle to survive, lost at sea.

a-bird-in-a-bonnet.title: A Bird in a Bonnet
a-bird-in-a-bonnet.desc: The chase continues between Tweety Bird and that persistant puddy tat, Sylvester. Tweety hides in a millinery store (where Granny happens to be shopping) and hides on a hat.

a-bird-in-a-guilty-cage.title: A Bird in a Guilty Cage
a-bird-in-a-guilty-cage.desc: Sylvester Cat spots Tweety Bird in a display window of an after-hours department store and sneaks inside through a mail server chute. Tweety flees Sylvester by hiding in a hat pile and a doll house, evades the shots from a rifle Sylvester uses, and escapes in a vacuum tube. Tweety sends a dynamite stick through another tube, and Sylvester swallows it, thinking it is Tweety. The dynamite blows up inside Sylvester after the cat leaves the store and walks down the street.

bird-karma.title: Bird Karma
bird-karma.desc: A tale of a long-legged bird's journey of blissful joy, inescapable greed and the accidental discovery of the consequences when too much is not enough.

bird-shit.title: Bird Shit
bird-shit.desc: Sometimes, abstraction can be found in the everyday, right underneath your feet. In fact, sometimes it kind of finds you. You just have to look hard enough.

birdbox.title: BirdBox
birdbox.desc: Using recycled Pandemic Parcel cardboard boxes as the primary material to make the models to depict traditional stop-motion animation equipment and methods.

birdboy.title: Birdboy
birdboy.desc: A terrible industrial accident changes little Dinki's life forever. Now Dinki's fate may ride on the wings of her eccentric friend Birdboy, a misfit who hides in the forest lost in his fantasies.

birdman.title: Birdman
birdman.desc: A portrait of Robert, a troubled but poetic soul struggling with his purgatorial existence in a hackney scrapyard.

birds-1981.title: Birds
birds-1981.desc: A film study in which the symbol of flight which contradicts human limitations inspires an emotional rhythm of scenes varying along three lines: the human desire for the sky (the first attempts for flight), the death of birds (experiments on animals) and the death of a human being in heights (a fall which isn´t a flight).

birds-2021-1.title: Birds
birds-2021-1.desc: Young love, adventure, and coming-of-age moments in the heat of Texas summer.

birds-anonymous.title: Birds Anonymous
birds-anonymous.desc: In this spoof of Alcoholics Anonymous, pussycats are cast as bird-eating addicts and go through the 12-step process to deal with their addiction. Sylvester, who could never quite get the best of the object of his desire, Tweety Bird, joins and resolves to quit chasing and eating the canary.

birds-by-the-sea-prayer.title: Birds by the Sea (Prayer)
birds-by-the-sea-prayer.desc: For quite some time i have been fascinated by the spectacular beauty of the 13th Century Roman Liturgy for Easter. AUgustin's (Philosopher and church teacher who lived during the transition from the Antique to the Middle Ages) words about the art of the Sequence, which at the time were refered to by the singers as a work of music, inspired me to undertake the attempt to produce a film, one which essentially reflects what Augusrin heard. Indeed what did je hear? A form of communiction which didn't ne cessitate the spoken word, but one in which one spirit to another was revealed. I have presented here a Visual Sequence to the musical sequence.

birds-in-the-earth.title: Birds in the Earth
birds-in-the-earth.desc: Sami dance students Birit and Katja Haarla dance through the villages and lost woods of Sápmi all the way to where the important decisions are made. The polarity of Nature and the Western way of life is filtered through sharp humour.

birds-in-the-spring.title: Birds in the Spring
birds-in-the-spring.desc: Two birds rejoice over the hatching of their three eggs; as they grow, the hatchlings are taught to sing and fly. One falls from the nest and has adventures with a rattlesnake and a beehive before finding his way home.

birds-of-a-father.title: Birds of a Father
birds-of-a-father.desc: Sylvester Cat discovers that his son, Junior, has a new best friend - a bird named Spike. Aghast, Sylvester decides to teach his son the facts of feline life and goes with him on a bird hunt, which, as usual, isn't Sylvester's forte. He is hit with a badminton racket after he mistakenly shoots a badminton birdie and then is blown up when he sends a model plane after Spike and is himself shot at by the out-of-control plane and forced to take refuge in an explosives store shed, with the plane slipping in behind him and firing at the TNT.

birds-of-a-feather-1931.title: Birds of a Feather
birds-of-a-feather-1931.desc: Swans, peacocks, ducks, and more birds dance.

the-birds-of-paradise.title: The Birds Of Paradise
the-birds-of-paradise.desc: This is a hand-painted work which involves a variety of colors applied within gouged and scratched shapes which approximate both swift shifts of bird-shape (legs, beaks and feather-spreads especially) and the Bird of Paradise flower-form as well, the former tending to metamorphize into the latter across the course of the work. Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in 2017.

birds-one.title: Birds, One
birds-one.desc: A woman plays with a bird as the camera's gaze is drawn to her legs.

birdy-and-the-beast.title: Birdy and the Beast
birdy-and-the-beast.desc: Tweety is set upon by a fat, jowly cat, who winds up with, among other things, a dozen eggs and a gallon of gasoline in his mouth instead of the little bird.

birth-of-a-leader.title: Birth of a Leader
birth-of-a-leader.desc: Vincent, a 20-year-old successful actor, is being offered the leading role in the film of the year: a biopic on Charles de Gaulle in his youth. At the same time, his parents move to Orléans, thus pushing him to live alone. The film follows his first steps towards independence.

birth-of-a-notion.title: Birth of a Notion
birth-of-a-notion.desc: Daffy Duck, hoping to avoid flying south by finding a sucker who will let him stay, ends up at the house of a mad scientist and his dog, Leopold.

the-birth-of-magellan-cadenza-i.title: The Birth of Magellan: Cadenza I
the-birth-of-magellan-cadenza-i.desc: Hollis Frampton alludes to origins and creation as he cuts between a garden featuring a bride and groom and an 1902 film entitled "A Little Piece of String."

the-birth-of-the-american-flag.title: The Birth of the American Flag

the-birth-of-the-goalie-of-the-2001-fa-c.title: The Birth of the Goalie of the 2001 F.A. Cup Final
the-birth-of-the-goalie-of-the-2001-fa-c.desc: A slow-witted couple decide to start a family.

birth-of-the-pearl.title: Birth of the Pearl
birth-of-the-pearl.desc: In this picture there is a limited amount of action in the pose. As the curtains are drawn aside the shell appears shut. It gradually opens, disclosing the model curled up in a recumbent position. She slowly arises as if awakening, and gracefully assumes the final position of the pose.

the-birth-of-the-robot.title: The Birth of the Robot
the-birth-of-the-robot.desc: This experiment was a “prestige advertisement” for Shell Motor Oil. As conventional animation became dominated by Walt Disney, many European filmmakers turned to puppets as an alternative, and Lye enlisted the help of avant-garde friends such as Humphrey Jennings and John Banting to make the amusing puppets. Exploring the still-complex color process, which involved the combination of three separate images, Lye creates such a vivid storm scene that reviewers hailed it as “proof that the color film has entered a new stage.” The music is Holst’s The Planets. - Harvard Film Archive

birthday-bad-kid-stuff.title: Birthday (Bad Kid Stuff)
birthday-bad-kid-stuff.desc: Roxy goes on a birthday adventure with Jazz.

birthday-boy.title: Birthday Boy
birthday-boy.desc: Korean War, 1951 Little Manuk is playing on the streets of his village and dreaming of life at the front where his father is a soldier. He returns home to find a parcel on the doorstep and, thinking it is a birthday present, he opens it. But its contents will change his life.

birthday-party.title: Birthday Party
birthday-party.desc: A film which uses the device of developing Polaroid camera shots to present the highlights of a family celebration during the birthday of filmmaker Tony Buba.

the-birthday-party.title: The Birthday Party
the-birthday-party.desc: Mickey's friends throw him a surprise birthday party at Minnie's house. The chef brings out the cake (with 2 candles); Mickey manages to blow all the cake onto the chef's face, while the candles stay lit. He unwraps his present: a miniature piano. He plays a duet of I Can't Give You Anything But Love, Baby with Minnie, followed by an instrumental version of The Darktown Strutter's Ball, which everyone dances to (including Mickey and Minnie, while the piano stools keep playing). Mickey then plays There's No Place Like Home on the xylophone, then accompanies Minnie on another piece, after which the xylophone gets frisky and eventually dumps Mickey in the fish bowl.

the-birthday-party-1993.title: The Birthday Party
the-birthday-party-1993.desc: A queer girl’s fantasy of the best birthday party a mother could give. Being queer, the “sweet sixteen” character has only two girlfriends to invite to her party: one is the daughter of Jehovah’s Witnesses, the other a precocious slut. The party is depicted primarily in long shots in a 1960s home-movie style. The mother is a hippie (played by a drag queen) who believes in free love, communal living and crazy parties. She has her boyfriend serve cake to the girls and brings in a male dancer and a female sex worker to entertain them.

birthday-suit-2013.title: Birthday Suit
birthday-suit-2013.desc: "A Super 8 film I made on my birthday this year, at Ingleton waterfalls in Yorkshire. Edited in camera and processed by hand. A love affair with water, my first word." — M.J.

the-bitches-of-bowery.title: The Bitches of Bowery
the-bitches-of-bowery.desc: A vicious man-hating leather-wearing girl gang named 'The Bitches' terrorize the streets of the Lower East Side. When an innocent school girl wanders into a nearby bar to meet her date, 'The Bitches' take her under their wings.

the-bitches.title: The Bitches
the-bitches.desc: Two girls are in a sparsely furnished apartment, scantily clad, and being generally unpleasant to each other.

a-bitter-message-of-hopeless-grief.title: A Bitter Message of Hopeless Grief
a-bitter-message-of-hopeless-grief.desc: Living in a fictional world all their own, the machines of Survival Research Laboratories act out scenarios of perpetual torment, exasperating consumption, and tragic recognition

bitter-orange.title: Bitter Orange
bitter-orange.desc: Despite her short skirt and bobbed hair, Myrtle’s no flapper—she’s a career girl with her eye on the prize. But over the course of an evening in the company of Jack, a bootlegger, she’s forced to ask herself what she really wants: a legitimate career, or success at any cost.

bitzbutz.title: Bitzbutz
bitzbutz.desc: In Israeli director Gil Alkabetz's playful study in contrasts, a white bird and a black monster compete for common territory, but, as they soon find out, it's a zero-sum game.

black-and-white-1932.title: Black and White
black-and-white-1932.desc: The film addresses issues of racism in the Jim Crow American South. Themes of racial injustice, racial violence, working-class solidarity dominate the film. It depicts black men working in a field, walking in chains, sitting behind bars, and being executed in an electric chair. In most scenes, a white authority figure is seen whipping or guarding the men.

black-and-white-film.title: Black and White Film
black-and-white-film.desc: “For Black and White Film, Huot created his own photographic imagery for the first time. After a few moments of darkness, a young woman (Sheila Raj) lowers a covering of some kind, slowly revealing her naked body. She reaches outside the circle of light, which illuminates only her silvery form, scoops up dark paint, and, beginning with her feet, gradually paints her entire body. When she has become invisible except for the faint sheen of the paint, she drops her arms, looks straight ahead, and the film fades to total darkness. The serenity of the film, which is structurally reflected by Huot’s presentation of the action from a single position in a single take, its sensuality, and the aura…

black-and-white-rhapsody.title: Black and White Rhapsody
black-and-white-rhapsody.desc: ČERNOBÍLÁ RAPSODIE (1936) Black and White Rhapsody Directed by Mac Frič Cinematography: Ferdinand Pečenka Starring: Studio of Marta Fričová Black and White Rhapsody is one of the earlier films by Mac Frič, who is considered to be one of the most important directors of Czechoslovakia.

black-and-white-trypps-number-four.title: Black and White Trypps Number Four
black-and-white-trypps-number-four.desc: Using a 35mm strip of motion picture slug featuring the recently deceased American comedian Richard Pryor, this extended Rorschach assault on the eyes moves out of a flickering chaos created by incompatible film gauges into a punchline involving historically incompatible racial stereotypes.

black-and-white-trypps-number-one.title: Black and White Trypps Number One
black-and-white-trypps-number-one.desc: "A night sky fills with light shimmers and flecks, surface markings, heavenly bodies. It’s an ocean, a well, a screen, a mirror, a portal. Blackness/void cluttered by growing ephemera. Dark reaches of outer and inner space gradually sifts through shards of granite and diamonds. The mind races as the material becomes greater and more frenetic, reaching a nearly audibly grinding pitch of excitement, flurry, and instantaneous infinity that ebbs at first and then maintains. Flashes of color emerge or are imagined. Chaotic flickering of dancing peasant girls and violently twisting astronaut helmets. Layers of sea slime over undulating life forms. Bonfires and celebration. Explosions,…

black-and-white-trypps-number-three.title: Black and White Trypps Number Three
black-and-white-trypps-number-three.desc: The third part in a series of films dealing with naturally-derived psychedelia. Shot during a performance by Rhode Island noise band Lightning Bolt, this film documents the transformation of a rock audience’s collective freak-out into a trance ritual of the highest spiritual order.

black-and-white-trypps-number-two.title: Black and White Trypps Number Two
black-and-white-trypps-number-two.desc: "A fine fine example of spaces between existing as objects themselves. A patternistic and memorializing offering to natural totems. Two kinds of reversal at play involving black and white as well as reflection and overlap. These simple elements create a hurried maze of twisting antler branches, twigs, and dissected slices of pure “space.” I can hear the crackling fires, echoing elk calls and frosty despair…" - JT Rogstad, The International Exposition

black-and-white-day-and-night.title: Black and White, Day and Night
black-and-white-day-and-night.desc: A 'drawn' film, with images that are constantly changing, drawings of landscapes that keep escaping, traces of faces, everything is almost what it is but never stays that way. The soundtrack punches out a wild monotone of dirty, nonsense limericks to the accompaniment of hand-drawn images related only in their complementary rhythm.

black-balls-1969.title: Black Balls
black-balls-1969.desc: In this film, Nauman applies black makeup to his testicles. The action was recorded with an industrial high-speed camera capable of shooting between one thousand and four thousand frames per second.

black-barbie.title: Black Barbie
black-barbie.desc: ​Black Barbie is a spoken/poetry animation that explores the filmmaker's experience with skin bleaching. The film explores issues of colorism and self image.

black-bodies.title: Black Bodies
black-bodies.desc: Following a Black man on his marathon through life as he comes face-to-face with the realities of being Black in 2020.

black-bus-stop.title: Black Bus Stop
black-bus-stop.desc: Students reclaim a popular gathering spot on the campus of the University of Virginia, Charlottesville.

black-button.title: Black Button
black-button.desc: Mr Roberts finds himself awoken inexplicably in a white room. A man sits before him at a desk and in between them stands a black button. If Mr Roberts pushes it, he will receive a briefcase filled with millions of dollars. Or he can take the key to the door and leave penniless. The catch? Pushing the button will result in the death of a human being. What would you do?

black-cats-and-broomsticks.title: Black Cats and Broomsticks
black-cats-and-broomsticks.desc: Superstitions are examined in the context of mid-20th century America. Walking under ladders, spilt salt, stepping on cracks, haunted houses, voodoo dolls, and such are used to illustrate the widespread belief in the supernatural.

black-diamond-express.title: Black Diamond Express
black-diamond-express.desc: This picture was taken at one of the curves on the Lehigh Valley Railroad, along the beautiful Susquehanna River. The train is seen rapidly approaching in the distance, clearly outlined against the grey mountains. Smoke can be seen pouring in volumes from the stack of the locomotive, and as the train approaches closely, she sounds a whistle, warning some section men, who are working on the tracks in the foreground. As she rushes by the camera, the swing motion of the train gives a vivid idea of the lightning speed at which she is traveling. (Edison film catalog)

the-black-duck.title: The Black Duck
the-black-duck.desc: Okay, this is an entry in the "Aesop's Sound Fables" and is a version of the little-black-duck and the wolf-in-sheep's clothing fables about the sibling duck who was shunned because of his color, and not because of race.

the-black-hand-1906.title: The Black Hand
the-black-hand-1906.desc: Two gang members send a threatening letter to a butcher, demanding money if he did not want his shop to be destroyed and his daughter Maria kidnapped. When he is unable to meet their request, they take Maria away. The Black Hand is the earliest surviving gangster film.

black-hole.title: Black Hole
black-hole.desc: Short film directed by Rupert Sanders based on the comic book by Charles Burns. The story deals with the aftermath of a sexually transmitted disease which causes grotesque mutations in teenagers.

the-black-hole-2008.title: The Black Hole
the-black-hole-2008.desc: Charlie, a sleep-deprived office worker accidentally produces a black hole out of the photocopy machine - and then he gets greedy...

black-holes-2017.title: Black Holes
black-holes-2017.desc: Dave is about to lead the first mission to Mars when he’s teamed up with a sentient melon, who claims to be the reincarnation of a fashion designer, upstaging his big moment and driving him to the brink of madness.
black-holes-2017.director: Kevin Van Der Meiren, David Nicolas, Laurent Nicolas

black-holes-2015.title: Black Holes
black-holes-2015.desc: cel animation, repetition, and disappearance... color, sound, 5:20 loop, 2015

black-hula.title: Black Hula
black-hula.desc: A dirge-like hula song illustrates humanity's woes. Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in 2010.

the-black-imp.title: The Black Imp
the-black-imp.desc: A traveler at an inn is harassed by a mischievous devil in his room.

black-is.title: Black Is
black-is.desc: To the sound of a heartbeat and made entirely without the use of a camera, this film projects abstract forms and illuminations on a night-black background and suggests as Tambellini says, “seed black, seed black, sperm black, sperm black.”

black-mass-2017.title: Black Mass
black-mass-2017.desc: A social outcast named James stumbles into a very accepting community, the caveat being that the community is a satanic cult.

black-metal.title: Black Metal
black-metal.desc: After a career spent mining his music from the shadows, one fan creates a chain reaction for the lead singer of a black metal band.

black-mirror.title: Black Mirror
black-mirror.desc: A nameless drifter navigates a barren landscape punctuated by satellite dishes, radio towers and droning airplanes. Stopping periodically in anonymous hotel rooms, she makes attempts to connect to an unidentified second party.

black-mirror-at-the-national-gallery.title: Black Mirror at the National Gallery
black-mirror-at-the-national-gallery.desc: Black Mirror at The National Gallery is a single uninterrupted shot of a black circular mirror (designed by Martin Szekely) as it travels through the Dutch Landscape and Genre Scenes painting rooms at London’s National Gallery.

black-plus-x.title: Black Plus X
black-plus-x.desc: Tambellini here focuses on contemporary life in a black community. The extra, the “X” of Black Plus X, is a filmic device by which a black person is instantaneously turned white by the mere projection of the negative image. The time is summer, and the place is an oceanside amusement park where black children are playing in the surf and enjoying the rides, quite oblivious to Tambellini’s tongue-in-cheek “solution” to the race problem.

black-rain-white-scars.title: Black Rain White Scars
black-rain-white-scars.desc: Black Rain White Scars depicts a twilight of reality. With the steady shot of a Gotham-like cityscape, Lukas Marxt guides us between vestiges of visionary architecture and narrow planted apartment buildings. As we’re searching for our relational point within it, the overwhelming murmuring of the human, car, and boat traffic, at the same time marginalises our position. We are a part of the scenery, though secluded and apart from it.

black-rider.title: Black Rider
black-rider.desc: A young black man is verbally harassed by an older woman on a streetcar, while the other passengers remain silent. He finally exacts his revenge.

black-september.title: Black September
black-september.desc: A low budget dramatization of 1972 Munich Olympics hostage crisis combining appropriated footage and re-enactments.

black-sheep-boy-2020.title: Black Sheep Boy
black-sheep-boy-2020.desc: In a world which resembles a computer game from bygone times, an unloved boy embarks upon a search for answers to the essential questions: How does one become happy in life? Is there a “real me”, or do we just play some character?

black-slide.title: Black Slide
black-slide.desc: Eviah, a young and timid kid on the brink of puberty and his best friend sneak into the Black slide, the most terrifying ride in Aqua Fun. There Eviah will gain insight to prepare him for events about to unfold at home. Eviah is about to confront more than just a scary slide.

black-something.title: Black Something
black-something.desc: In late 2015, "Bright Ideas" magazine and its publisher, the innovative crowdfunding and distribution platform Seed & Spark, commissioned directing duo the Zellner Bros. (KUMIKO, THE TREASURE HUNTER) to make a short piece in response to a Criterion Collection release that they considered inspiring. The brothers chose Louis Malle's wild, hallucinogenic BLACK MOON (1975), itself a tripped-out reimagining of "Alice in Wonderland." Shot in the woods near their Austin homes, BLACK SOMETHING captures Malle's blending of idyllic pastoral imagery with nightmarish fantasy, distilling it into a skin-crawlingly unsettling three-minute short.

black-soul.title: Black Soul
black-soul.desc: Painted directly on glass, Black Soul is an exhilarating immersion into the heart of Black culture—a whirlwind voyage through the defining moments of Black History.

black-sun-1996.title: Black Sun
black-sun-1996.desc: An experimental film by Boyd Rice "…like a hallucinatory motion picture Rorschach test, incorporating sound, rhythm, and archetypal symbology."

black-sun-2019.title: Black Sun
black-sun-2019.desc: Underscored by French film legend Delphine Seyrig’s evocative recitation of a Henri Michaux poem, Maureen Fazendeiro’s film is a mysterious, multi-textured portrait of eclipse spectators in Portugal.

black-swell.title: Black Swell
black-swell.desc: A man tries to kill himself in a motel room.

black-trip.title: Black Trip
black-trip.desc: Through the uses of kinescope, video, multimedia, and direct painting on film, an impression is gained of the frantic action of protoplasm under a microscope where an imaginative viewer may see the genesis of it all. – Grove Press Film Catalog

black-trip-2.title: Black Trip 2
black-trip-2.desc: “An internal probing of the violence and mystery of the American psyche seen through the eye of a black man and the Russian revolution.”– A.T.

black-tv.title: Black TV
black-tv.desc: Black TV is the title of Tambellini’s best-known videographic film, which is part of a large intermedia project about American television. Compiled from filmed television news programs and personal experimental videotapes, Black TV has been seen in many versions during the four-year period in which Tambellini constantly re-edited it (1964-68).

sartres-nausea.title: Sartre's Nausea
sartres-nausea.desc: This film has never been in distribution, and it’s arguably not a true Brakhage film, as it was made as a commission for a 1961 public television program on KRMA-TV in Boulder (but aired nationally), called Self Encounter: A Study in Existentialism, created and hosted by Hazel Barnes, an acclaimed scholar on the subject. This film was featured in an episode entitled “To Leap or Not to Leap”, originally broadcast on April 19, 1961. I’ve included Sartre’s Nausea in the main body of the filmography because despite its origin as a commissioned work to be incorporated into a show on existentialism, and even having no main title or credit on the film, Brakhage came back to this piece a few years…

blackadder-the-cavalier-years.title: Blackadder: The Cavalier Years
blackadder-the-cavalier-years.desc: A short movie, made for Comic Relief, in which Blackadder (Rowan Atkinson) and Baldrick (Tony Robinson) must help protect King Charles I (Stephen Fry) from the machinations of Oliver Cromwell and his Roundheads

blackbird-1958.title: Blackbird
blackbird-1958.desc: To the tune of a classic French-Canadian nonsense song, surreal blackbird made of lines loses body parts and gets them back threefold.

blackboard-jumble.title: Blackboard Jumble
blackboard-jumble.desc: A wolf with a Southern accent walks by just as a teacher is getting fed up with his class and walks out. Unfortunately, the class consists of three junior clones of Droopy, who manage to try his patience.

the-blackest-sea.title: The Blackest Sea
the-blackest-sea.desc: "Refashioning the intent of footage lifted from an online Taiwanese news outlet, this cautionary tale is about the inexplicable sea - a poetic tour through the obsession to conquer the Great Whale to the current crisis of the migrants fleeing war." - Peggy Ahwesh

blackfly.title: Blackfly
blackfly.desc: A young surveyer, new to Ontario, encounters the blackflies. Over and over again, he encounters those blackflies.

blackford-manor.title: Blackford Manor
blackford-manor.desc: Josette is a sweet and curious young maid at gloomy Blackford Manor, whose master has a very disturbing secret.

blackfriars-bridge.title: Blackfriars Bridge
blackfriars-bridge.desc: Top-hatted pedestrians and horse-drawn traffic pass over Blackfriars Bridge in London.

blackout-1965.title: Blackout
blackout-1965.desc: This film, like an action painting by Franz Kline, is a rising crescendo of abstract images. Rapid cuts of white forms on a black background supplemented by an equally abstract soundtrack give the impression of a bombardment in celestial space or on a battlefield where cannons fire on an unseen enemy in the night.

blacksmith-scene.title: Blacksmith Scene
blacksmith-scene.desc: Three men hammer on an anvil and pass a bottle of beer around. Notable for being the first film in which a scene is being acted out.

the-blacksmiths-daughter.title: The Blacksmith's Daughter
the-blacksmiths-daughter.desc: A girl elopes but is deserted by her husband. After her baby dies, she returns home to her father.

blacksmiths.title: Blacksmiths
blacksmiths.desc: While his aide continuously turns the handle of the bellows, keeping hot a small furnace in front of him, a blacksmith is pounding a piece of metal on an anvil, then plunges the shaft into a tub of water, causing a cloud of vapor in the process.

blank-narcissus-passion-of-the-swamp.title: Blank Narcissus (Passion of the Swamp)
blank-narcissus-passion-of-the-swamp.desc: An ageing director commentates on a porno he directed 50 years ago, reminiscing on his relationship with the lead actor.

blanket-statement-1-home-is-where-the-he.title: Blanket Statement #1: Home Is Where the Heart Is
blanket-statement-1-home-is-where-the-he.desc: Discordant dysfunction down to the nitty griddy.

blanket-statement-2-its-all-or-nothing.title: Blanket Statement #2: It's All or Nothing
blanket-statement-2-its-all-or-nothing.desc: A quilted call and response. A battle of extreme extremes.

the-blanket.title: The Blanket
the-blanket.desc: Shot and crewed by Riley Stearns while in quarantine, and described as "an exercise in trusting instincts and embracing limitations."

the-blanket-2022.title: The Blanket
the-blanket-2022.desc: Ten-year-old Marja is sent to fetch milk for her baby brother. On the way there are things even more dangerous than the thin ice.

blanketyy.title: Blanketyy
blanketyy.desc: A Woman attempts to exploit the human experience to use as a dataset for a program that will generate an infinite number of scenarios through machine learning. Unfortunately, as the computer continues to fail, the people contributing to the dataset start running out of ideas.

blaze-glory.title: Blaze Glory
blaze-glory.desc: A stop-motion parody of the Western genre.

blazes.title: Blazes
blazes.desc: 100 basic images switching positions for 4000 frames.

blessed-are-the-dreams-of-men.title: Blessed are the Dreams of Men
blessed-are-the-dreams-of-men.desc: Moving towards an unknown destination, a group of anonymous passengers float through an unidentified landscape

blight.title: Blight
blight.desc: A short film featuring the voices of those affected when the M11 Link Road in East London was built, accompanied by scenes and sounds of demolition.

blind-eye-2019.title: Blind Eye
blind-eye-2019.desc: In a world that worships the Almighty Eye, two siblings find themselves escaping from sacrifice, only to discover their world is not what it appeared to be.
blind-eye-2019.director: Rohit Kelkar, Yujia Wang, Germaine Colajanni, Isabela Littger de Pinho, Rohan Deshchougule, Diego Porral, Bruno Cohen

the-blind-man-of-jerusalem.title: The Blind Man of Jerusalem
the-blind-man-of-jerusalem.desc: A rich man, living in a splendid palace, in the city of Jerusalem, with his daughter and many servants, surrounded by every possible luxury, but blind, is healed of his affliction by Christ. Having regained his sight he does not make this known to his household, but quietly observes them for a time and sees how his servants rob him and even his daughter imposes upon him. Discouraged at his findings he goes out upon the highway where he again meets Christ, but this time He is carrying His cross and being led to Calvary. The sight of the suffering Savior teaches him to forgive his offenders.

blind-song.title: Blind Song
blind-song.desc: Small piece of life in the streets of Ho Chi Minh.

blind-vaysha.title: Blind Vaysha
blind-vaysha.desc: From the moment she was born, Vaysha was a very special girl. With her left eye she can only see into the past, and with her right she can only see the future.

blink-1966.title: Blink
