helluva-boss.desc: Starring the incredible talents of Brandon Rogers, Richard Horvitz, Erica Lindbeck, and Brock Baker! In HELL, imps are the lowest of the low in society, but what happens when one starts an assassin business? This happens! Follow Blitzo (the 'o' is silent) as he attempts to run a startup killing company in a very competitive market, along with his weapons specialist Moxxie, his powerhouse Millie, and his receptionist hellhound Loona. With the help of an ancient book obtained by one of the princes of Hell, they manage to make their work possible and together they attempt to survive each other while trying to keep their business afloat. Bad Language warning! Not meant for kids or probably some…

helmer-son.title: Helmer & Son
helmer-son.desc: A family is called together in unusual circumstances when a nursing home rings them all for help when there elderly father locks himself in a closet and refuses to come out. Nominated for an Oscar for Best Live Action Short Film.

help-2014.title: Help
help-2014.desc: The first live-action Spotlight Story, HELP, brings cinema-quality filmmaking to the world of 360 storytelling. Filmed with a groundbreaking and custom-built camera array system, HELP drops the audience into the middle of downtown Los Angeles where an unexpected meteor shower has left a deep scar on the streets of Chinatown. What happens next creates panic in the streets and sends a young woman scrambling to escape.

help-1992.title: Help!
help-1992.desc: A young man being followed by a stalker discovers there is more to his tormentor than meets the eye.

help-my-snowmans-burning-down.title: Help! My Snowman's Burning Down
help-my-snowmans-burning-down.desc: My Snowman's Burning Down is an American short film made by Carson Davidson in 1964, with music composed and performed by Gerry Mulligan. A surrealistic and humorous satire on the Madison Avenue image of the world through advertising. The film was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Live Action Short Film. Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in 2009.

helsinki-mansplaining-massacre.title: Helsinki Mansplaining Massacre
helsinki-mansplaining-massacre.desc: One woman’s desperate struggle to survive a horde of men with frail egos, who just want to explain everything to her. But the biggest horror may be closer to her than she thinks.

hen-hop.title: Hen Hop
hen-hop.desc: This joyful short animation features a dancing hen that transforms into an egg. The film was made without a camera by Norman McLaren, who drew directly onto 35 mm movie stock with ordinary pen and ink. Colour was added optically.

the-hen-that-laid-the-golden-eggs.title: The Hen That Laid the Golden Eggs
the-hen-that-laid-the-golden-eggs.desc: This has more of a clear narrative than most of the films in the set although it’s still quite odd and random compared to today’s films. There are some effectively surreal and creepy sequences in this imaginative short, such as the devil’s face appearing in an egg and spewing coins as well as the finale where our protagonist is sent to an egg-filled hell.

hen-his-wife.title: Hen, His Wife
hen-his-wife.desc: Extraordinarily detailed and beautifully drawn animation of a bizarre and surreal world; the domestic life of a fat man, his wife, a sort of oversized obese chicken, and their child/pet, a slug-like creature with a human head. This expressionistic and interior vision of Soviet animator Kovalyov is like an animated Eraserhead.

the-henpecked-duck.title: The Henpecked Duck
the-henpecked-duck.desc: Mrs. Duck sues Daffy for divorce in Judge Porky Pig's courtroom, charging her husband with losing their egg in an abortive magic trick.

henpecked-hoboes.title: Henpecked Hoboes
henpecked-hoboes.desc: George and Junior are two hungry bears who try to make a meal out of a not too bright barnyard chicken.

henry-9-til-5.title: Henry 9 'til 5
henry-9-til-5.desc: A boring commuter fantasises about his sex life; when he gets home he is too exhausted to make love to his sexy wife.

the-hep-cat.title: The Hep Cat
the-hep-cat.desc: A cat-about-town fancies himself such an irresistible "hunk" he momentarily resembles Victor Mature. His wooing of a cute kitten gets derailed by a prankster dog using a cat hand puppet to trap him.

her-first-biscuits.title: Her First Biscuits
her-first-biscuits.desc: A new bride has made a batch of biscuits. Her husband pretends to like them, so she delivers the rest to his office. But one bite of these biscuits makes you violently ill, and soon all his visitors (he runs a theatrical booking agency), plus the workmen at home, are ill; when she shows up at the office, they all go after her.

her-fragrant-emulsion.title: Her Fragrant Emulsion
her-fragrant-emulsion.desc: “Her Fragrant Emulsion is an obsessional homage to the ’60s B-film actress Mimsy Farmer. The film’s visceral collage images act as a metaphor for sensuality and move in and out of sync with the soundtrack to evoke the distancing and intimacy cycles that are common in love relationships.”—Lewis Klahr

her-glacial-speed.title: Her Glacial Speed
her-glacial-speed.desc: The world as seen in a teardrop of milk. I set out to make a film about how unwitting constellations of meaning rise to a surface of understanding at a pace outside of worldly time. This premise became a self fulfilling prophecy. An unexpected interior began to unfold, made palpable by a trauma that remains abstract.

her-heart-is-washed-in-water-and-then-we.title: Her Heart Is Washed in Water and Then Weighed
her-heart-is-washed-in-water-and-then-we.desc: A meditation on motherhood and mortality that takes its title from a procedure in the autopsying of a human corpse. Subtle juxtapositions evoke parallels between static monuments and living families to suggest what is lost to time and age. When you die, everything you know, including this, disappears.

her-silent-seaming.title: Her Silent Seaming
her-silent-seaming.desc: A transcription of what I have been told during intimate experiences while separating from my husband. Sections consist of destroyed originals from Leafless (2011) and motifs of the “feminine”. These decorative objects are re-valued through a controlled act of cutting, with an allusion to synchronization. Direct sound of cuts and hand processing are composed of 26 frame shots. Un-synced, it reveals a hearing of past images, as an act of translation.

her-love-in-the-modern-age.title: Her: Love in the Modern Age
her-love-in-the-modern-age.desc: Her: Love In The Modern Age chronicles reactions to Spike Jonze's Oscar-nominated film, "Her." The documentary, directed by Lance Bangs, features stories and reflections from writers, musicians, actors and contemporary culture experts, including Olivia Wilde, James Murphy and Bret Easton Ellis, on the film "Her," and their thoughts on love in the modern age.

herakles.title: Herakles
herakles.desc: Basically, 'Herakles' is an omnium-gatherum of film clips depicting images of machismo. Some of those images are explicitly macho: we see various body-builders flexing their biceps and triceps. Other images seen here are not macho in the literal sense, but are indirectly related to testosterone or cojones on some level: we see military aircraft making bombing raids, and footage of car crashes.

a-herb-alpert-the-tijuana-brass-double-f.title: A Herb Alpert & the Tijuana Brass Double Feature
a-herb-alpert-the-tijuana-brass-double-f.desc: A prototype of modern music videos, this is an animated film set to the music of two popular tunes recorded by Herb Alpert and his Latin-flavored brass ensemble - "Spanish Flea" and "Tijuana Taxi". Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in 2003.

herbert-white.title: Herbert White
herbert-white.desc: Michael Shannon stars in the role of Herbert White, a character based on the poem of the same name by Frank Bidart. The story follows Herbert as he works in the lumber industry, supports his family, and stalks and murders women he picks up in town. While Herbert is not exactly sympathetic, viewers are allowed to enter the mind of a serial killer, and realize that most of the time he behaves like everyone else. Movies like “Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer” have done this before, but to successfully position the audience inside the mind of a complex human monster in 14 short minutes is quite a feat.

herbie.title: Herbie
herbie.desc: Herbie is a short 16mm black and white film by George Lucas and Paul Golding made in 1966 as part of their USC film school course. It is an abstract film with no story and no actors, that graphically depicts the reflections of moving light streaks and light flashes from traffic at night. It is set to a piece of jazz music by Herbie Hancock, whose first name was used for the title.

herbst.title: Herbst
herbst.desc: An unseen teacher becomes frustrated as they try to teach a poem to a stuffed toy.

hercules-xena-wizards-of-the-screen.title: Hercules & Xena: Wizards of the Screen
hercules-xena-wizards-of-the-screen.desc: Members of the audience fight against stage performers set to a specially created Xena/Hercules movie.

here-and-the-great-elsewhere.title: Here and the Great Elsewhere
here-and-the-great-elsewhere.desc: This abstract yet compelling philosophical tale uses the Alexeïeff-Parker pinscreen as a metaphor for the particles that make up the universe. Through 4 tableaux that explore her character’s thoughts, filmmaker Michèle Lemieux takes a look at the profound reflections of this everyman, whose questions are part of humanity’s eternal quest for meaning.

here-and-there-1957.title: Here and There
here-and-there-1957.desc: Propulsive Polish avant-garde animation following clouds of shapes that resemble nebulae or stellar surfaces.

here-comes-dr-tran.title: Here Comes Dr. Tran
here-comes-dr-tran.desc: A young boy is shanghaied by American mass media into becoming a James Bond-esque character in a 30,000-strong film series with a cornucopia of product tie-ins.

here-even-so.title: Here Even So
here-even-so.desc: A semi-biographical, experimental short film about a woman who has just recently lost the man that she loved dearly. The filmmaker, Eli Hayes, who lost his father to esophageal cancer back in 2012 dedicates this film to his mother, who knows grief all too well. Here Even So, a silent, non-narrative film, concentrates on the internal, emotional state of a widow in the aftermath of losing her husband, and the stages of grief - progressing from fear of loneliness to eventual hope. All of the artwork in this short is art that was left behind by Eli's father, as he was a professor of art history at the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee prior to his passing. The film is shot in the Hayes…

here-i-am-1962.title: Here I Am
here-i-am-1962.desc: A sensitive, low-key portrait of the East Bay Activity Center, a school in Oakland, California, started in the 1950s to help emotionally disturbed children. The atmospheric documentary opens with hilly East Bay streets shrouded in fog. The mist lifts as the film moves to children at play. Often shown in unobtrusive close-up, the youngsters appear as thinking individuals, enjoying the swings, puzzling out problems, or interacting with their teacher in the classroom.

here-there-be-tygers.title: Here There Be Tygers
here-there-be-tygers.desc: Set in the future, a rocket ship from Earth travels to a far universe and touches down on an unknown planet with a mission to exploit its natural resources. However, this is planet is like no other, it seems to be alive.

here-today-gone-tamale.title: Here Today, Gone Tamale
here-today-gone-tamale.desc: Sylvester Cat won't allow starving Mexican mice access to a cache of cheeses on a ship and prompts a challenge by Speedy Gonzales, the fastest mouse in Mexico. Speedy makes several raids on the ship's stores by outsmarting Sylvester again and again.

heres-nudnik.title: Here's Nudnik
heres-nudnik.desc: Nudnik lives in the Withered Arms Apartments in what appears to be Manhattan. He wakes from his chair/bed and eventually escapes. He decides to start cooking and between expanding bread and a flooding sink creates disaster in his apartment.

heretic-1931.title: Heretic
heretic-1931.desc: Heretic is a modern dance work by Martha Graham performed to Tetus Breton, an old folk tune from Brittany.

hermit-crab.title: Hermit crab
hermit-crab.desc: Painlevé’s first film on animal behavior, focusing on the Hermit Crab. On this film we see the Hermit Crab trying to find shelter.

heroes-never-die.title: Heroes Never Die
heroes-never-die.desc: A 1990 short film from Alain Guiraudie concerning the conversations of two film makers as they meet each night.

the-heron-and-the-crane.title: The Heron and the Crane
the-heron-and-the-crane.desc: Animated short about a love between a heron and a crane.

herr-meets-hare.title: Herr Meets Hare
herr-meets-hare.desc: Bugs disguises himself as Hitler, Stalin and Brunhilde when he confronts Nazi Hermann Goering in the Black Forest.

a-hetedik-napon.title: A Hetedik napon
a-hetedik-napon.desc: A young priest visits a barber's shop to get shaved. When he leans back and closes his eyes, the barbers decide to play a prank on him. Instead of a male barber they let a female hairdresser take care of the shaving. When the priest feels her soft fingers on his skin, he opens his eyes and sees the woman. He cannot do anything but stay in the chair, as he has shaving cream all around his chin. The woman continues the shaving in a rather sensual way. When the priest leaves the barber's shop, he looks disconcerted.

heterodyne.title: Heterodyne
heterodyne.desc: “Geometric animation made entirely by sculptural methods: cutting, punching, welding colored leader. HETERODYNE is related to some of my other work as RNA to a protein or polypeptide. It was made in abject (if blissful) ignorance of Paul Sharits’ early work.” –Hollis Frampton

the-hex-of-ergot-popping-corn.title: The Hex of Ergot (Popping Corn)
the-hex-of-ergot-popping-corn.desc: "A Super 8 work entirely edited in camera, and shot and processed in one day during the Spur Exchange artist residency, ‘The hex of ergot (popping corn)’ is a musing on the connection between grain, ergot (a poisonous and sometimes hallucinogenic fungus that can grow when grain is damp), the witch-hunt trials in Salem in the 1690s, and consumerism in Leeds. While popcorn and cinema have a long and well-known affinity, the Spur Exchange residency took place in the Corn Exchange, where corn and other grains used to be traded. It’s now full of shops and restaurants, and has a carefully monitored aesthetic and ambience." — M.J.

hey-mister-lets-play-how-they-met-at-kol.title: Hey Mister, Let's Play! How They Met At Kolin
hey-mister-lets-play-how-they-met-at-kol.desc: Pilot of the series "Hey, Mister, Let's Play". The story of two bears, the older one is experienced and sly, the younger is naive and gullible. This is the story of how they met in the Czech town of Kolín.

hey-there.title: Hey There
hey-there.desc: In this early short Harold Lloyd sneaks into a movie studio in order to locate an attractive young lady he's just met at a snack bar. He's retrieved a letter she dropped and wants to return it to her, but it's pretty clear that his interest extends beyond mere politeness. (She's the adorable young Bebe Daniels, so this is easy to understand.) The movie studio setting provides Harold with lots of opportunities to do what comedians do in comedies like this one: flirt with actresses, anger the studio brass, and dash through sets disrupting everything.

hf.title: HF
hf.desc: HF is Benning’s tribute in miniature to legendary filmmaker Hollis Frampton, known for his materialist dissection of the cinema apparatus and adventurous considerations of memory and time.

hi-stranger.title: Hi Stranger
hi-stranger.desc: I made this film especially for you. I needed to check in with you. I needed to tell you how I feel.

hi-how-are-you-daniel-johnston.title: Hi, How Are You Daniel Johnston?
hi-how-are-you-daniel-johnston.desc: Daniel Johnston stars in this psychedelic short film about an aging musician coming to terms with the dreams of yesteryear.

hi-de-ho-1937.title: Hi-De-Ho
hi-de-ho-1937.desc: Young Cab Calloway's mother is concerned, because Cab spends his days listening to the radio, pretending to lead a miniature orchestra. A deacon passing by the apartment hears him singing and advises him go to his wife's gypsy tea room. As she reads the tea leaves, she sees situations which lead to Cab and his orchestra performing musical numbers.

hiawathas-rabbit-hunt.title: Hiawatha's Rabbit Hunt
hiawathas-rabbit-hunt.desc: Bugs Bunny is hunted by Hiawatha, a stereotyped Native American who fills roughly the same role as Elmer Fudd in other Bugs Bunny cartoons of this era.

hic-cup-pup.title: Hic-cup Pup
hic-cup-pup.desc: Spike has just put Tyke to bed for his nap when Tom and Jerry chase out the door to Tyke's crib, waking him up. This gives Tyke an attack of hiccups. Spike warns Tom not to wake him up again, which of course is all Jerry needs.

hiccups-2013.title: Hiccups
hiccups-2013.desc: When Lightning McQueen gets the hiccups, everyone in Radiator Springs thinks they have the cure.

the-hick-chick.title: The Hick Chick
the-hick-chick.desc: In this triangle drama a country chicken chooses between a country rooster and a city rooster.

hidden-mother.title: Hidden Mother
hidden-mother.desc: A recently-widowed mother is gifted an antique photo that happens to harbor the presence of a sinister spirit within its frame.

hidden-star.title: Hidden Star
hidden-star.desc: hidden star reveals itself only after a period of serious personal struggle. Each of us has their own star; you too can make it shine.

hide-and-go-seek.title: Hide and Go Seek
hide-and-go-seek.desc: A meditation on identity; a film about sisters and sisterhood, the boundaries of reality and fantasy, the relationship between humans and nature and what people leave behind after they disappear from the Earth.

hide-and-shriek.title: Hide and Shriek
hide-and-shriek.desc: Detective Alfalfa and his assistants Buckwheat and Porky try to solve a missing-candy case but find themselves in an amusement park haunted house.

hiding-under-a-copy-of-the-strokes-singl.title: Hiding Under a Copy of the Strokes' Single 'Under Cover of Darkness'
hiding-under-a-copy-of-the-strokes-singl.desc: Hiding inside&out, writhing about, taken out&in.

the-hierarchies-of-love.title: The Hierarchies of Love
the-hierarchies-of-love.desc: A pretty maid is out walking and encounters a series of military men, starting with a private, who lose her to higher ranks.

the-high-and-the-flighty.title: The High and the Flighty
the-high-and-the-flighty.desc: Salesman Daffy Duck comes upon a farm, the site of Foghorn Leghorn's ongoing feud with the barnyard dog, and proceeds to sell Foghorn and the dog contraptions to continue their violent, mutual heckling.

high-diving-hare.title: High Diving Hare
high-diving-hare.desc: Yosemite Sam tries to force Bugs Bunny to do a high-diving act when the regular act cancels.

high-diving-scene.title: High Diving Scene
high-diving-scene.desc: A daredevil rides his bicycle down a ramp and attempts to land in a pool of water as a crowd of spectators watches.

the-high-five.title: The High Five
the-high-five.desc: On October 2nd, 1977 Dusty Baker hit his 30th homerun of the season. As Baker rounded the bases, an excited rookie named Glenn Burke met him at home plate, raised his arm high in the air and slapped Baker's hand. It was the first high five recorded in the history of sports. A year later, Burke was forced out of baseball amid rumours of his sexual orientation.

high-kukus.title: High Kukus
high-kukus.desc: In this homage to Zen poet Basho, the subtle changes of a pond are chronicled on film over a period of time. Broughton recites his cuckoo haikus in the background.

high-maintenance.title: High Maintenance
high-maintenance.desc: In the near-future, a woman whose robotic husband fails to meet her standards returns and upgrades him for a better version with standards that she now fails to meet.

high-noon-on-the-waterfront.title: High Noon on the Waterfront
high-noon-on-the-waterfront.desc: An inventive remembrance of the impact of the Hollywood blacklist on two American classics, rendered as a visually mesmerizing dialogue between Carl Foreman and Elia Kazan.

high-note.title: High Note
high-note.desc: The sheet music for Johann Strauss' The Blue Danube is constructed by moving musical symbols. A baton-toting conductor note tries to direct his fellow notes in performing this musical piece, but finds that one of the notes has become drunk.

the-high-song.title: The High Song
the-high-song.desc: Filmed largely in close-up, this documentary records a woman giving birth while her husband remains at her side. The camera concentrates on her face throughout labor, briefly revealing the moment of the child’s arrival before the newborn is placed in her arms.

highjacker.title: Highjacker
highjacker.desc: A troubled man tries to highjack a ferry in order to go to Bolivia.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.desc: Lights flicker & fade as focus shifts from artificial to natural light, ending on a second artificial light speeding through the blackened miasma of the night sky.

a-highly-committed-film.title: A Highly Committed Film
a-highly-committed-film.desc: An amusing tale of the decline of cultural life due to the... the liquidation of old street kiosks pasted with posters, thanks to which one could find out about the dates of cultural events....

highway-1958.title: Highway
highway-1958.desc: Hilary Harris’ nervy tour of Robert Moses’ New York hearkens back to the classic city symphonies of the 1920s but cut to fit the “go go go” energy of the new era. “The most exciting thing in film is movement,” Harris once wrote, and in Highway he shows why, shooting from a moving car for the road itself of its ramps, signs and overall pretzel logic. The film can be enjoyed purely as a riot of graphic forms, but at a deeper level Harris is revising the traditional panorama to capture the automotive experience of urban space. He peppers the expressway view with all manner of camera effects, but it’s finally his simple fascination with the changing shape of the road at speed that makes the…

highway-landscape.title: Highway Landscape
highway-landscape.desc: The filmmaker describes his work as 'a single take, fixed camera meditation on a dead rabbit on Highway No. 1, outside Iowa City.' As the viewer stares at the almost still-life, the elements of composition come together in sad juxtaposition; the silence of death is set off against the impersonal whizz of passing cars, their momentary appearance in the frame creating almost subliminal flashes of bright metallic color.

the-highway-sings.title: The Highway Sings
the-highway-sings.desc: Probably the best-known advertising film for Bata, where joke and irony meet commercial purposes. Tires are sent from rural countryside to the turmoil of the city to serve progress.

the-hilarious-posters.title: The Hilarious Posters
the-hilarious-posters.desc: A wall full of advertising posters comes to life.

hillbilly-hare.title: Hillbilly Hare
hillbilly-hare.desc: While vacationing in the Ozark Mountains, Bugs Bunny encounters Curt and Punkinhead Martin, two dimwitted hillbillies who are duped by Bugs into a violent square dance.

the-hills-of-marlik.title: The Hills of Marlik
the-hills-of-marlik.desc: This is a short documentary about Marlik hills and the archaeology's explorations there. But also it is about life, art, and the hope for a better tomorrow.

the-hills-with-james-franco-and-mila-kun.title: The Hills with James Franco and Mila Kunis

him-indoors.title: Him Indoors
him-indoors.desc: Gregory Brewster is a serial killer, only problem is, he's agoraphobic! Facing an impending eviction from his family home, Gregory has a plan that will save him from being subjected to the one thing he's terrified of... the outside world. Things don't quite go to plan however, when a surprise visit from his new neighbor finds him in a very awkward situation.

himala-a-dialectic-for-our-times.title: Himala: A Dialectic for Our Times
himala-a-dialectic-for-our-times.desc: To this day, Ishmael Bernal's movie Himala is still in our town, in our world. This will be reflected in the broader perspective of the majority, of the surrounding events. Beliefs still lie in the truth. Consciousness is still dominant at the level of illusion. The naive, savage, cruel, and selfish politics still prevail.

hindenburg-disaster-newsreel-footage.title: Hindenburg Disaster Newsreel Footage
hindenburg-disaster-newsreel-footage.desc: The airship Hindenburg, arriving from Europe, was being led to its mooring at Lakehurst, New Jersey when suddenly disaster struck. The hydrogen-filled zeppelin ignited, and was almost instantly transformed into an enormous fireball. In less than a minute, the entire ship had been consumed by flames. The Hindenburg explosion marked the end of the budding airship travel industry.

hot-pants.title: Hot Pants
hot-pants.desc: Johnny dances to a song by James Brown. The pants come down, the shirt comes off, the thing comes up, the stuff comes out.

hinterlands.title: Hinterlands
hinterlands.desc: Through a structuralist and simultaneously ambiguous form, the image's reality treads closer to the abstract, leaving the sunset and trees behind. As we enter the image's gloaming, it reveals its true eye: reality's pure haptic energy, where there is nothing but sonorous light, and the dregs of the Unknown.

hip-hip-hurry.title: Hip Hip-Hurry!
hip-hip-hurry.desc: Wile E. Coyote is once again after the Road Runner, this time resorting to hand grenades, dynamite, falling rocks and a speed potion (which contains vitamins R, P and M).

hiplet-because-we-can.title: Hiplet: Because We Can
hiplet-because-we-can.desc: The story of Hiplet, a dance craze fusing classical pointe technique with hip-hop and urban styles.

hipopotamy.title: Hipopotamy
hipopotamy.desc: A few naked women and children are bathing in a river. They are being secretly observed by a group of men who, at one point, decide to approach them in a violent manner, as if inspired by the behaviour of hippopotamuses.

his-better-elf.title: His Better Elf
his-better-elf.desc: Woody Woodpecker lives in a slum, and is fed up with his bills, wishing aloud that he were rich. At that moment, a four-leaf clover appears in the floorboards, and transforms into a leprechaun woodpecker, which grants Woody three wishes. Woody immediately wishes for immense wealth, and he gets it-- by robbing a bank without realizing it. A police chase follows; will Woody escape, and what will his other two wishes be?

his-eye-is-on-the-sparrow.title: His Eye Is on the Sparrow
his-eye-is-on-the-sparrow.desc: 16mm/Digital, color/b&w/sound Bruce Conner began working on By and By a documentary about The Soul Stirrers several decades ago shooting their reunion concert with four cameras and accumulating interview material. Conner was poised to finish the piece in the mid-'80s but the project was abandoned for a variety of financial and personal reasons. From the ashes of this project arises a new collage film miniature completed this year. His Eye Is on the Sparrow takes its name from a classic gospel song written by Civilla D. Martin and Charles H. Gabriel in 1906 often associated with Ethel Waters , Mahalia Jackson and most recently Lauryn Hill. The Soul Stirrers cut their version in Chicago on…

his-favorite-person.title: His Favorite Person
his-favorite-person.desc: A young man becomes increasingly unstable after the end of an important relationship.

his-first-cigar.title: His First Cigar
his-first-cigar.desc: The film is quite sophisticated for it's time with a relatively large number of scene changes as we follow Max's misadventures. It also features a close-up shot to show his reactions to the effects of the cigar he is smoking.

his-mouse-friday.title: His Mouse Friday
his-mouse-friday.desc: Tom is shipwrecked on an island, which is inhabited by at least one mouse - Jerry. To thwart the hungry cat, Jerry disguises himself as a cannibal.

his-pastimes.title: His Pastimes
his-pastimes.desc: Roy Smeck (1900-1994) sits on a bench in a garden. He's wearing a bow tie, a white on white shirt, and a sweater. First he plays the guitar, which is lying across his lap - it's a steel guitar sound using a slide in his left hand. Next he picks up the ukulele for an up-tempo number. After a few choruses, he stops and adds a mouth organ, playing it while both hands continue to play the uke. He finishes with a piece on a four-string banjo. With all three instruments, he gets percussive as well as melodic effects. Roy smiles a lot but doesn't say or sing a word.

his-regeneration.title: His Regeneration
his-regeneration.desc: A rough criminal gets a second chance at life thanks to a kindly (and wealthy) lady saloon patron. But he hasn't gone straight yet, as he and a partner attempt to rob the home of a rich homeowner-- whose wife is asleep in the next room.

his-trust.title: His Trust
his-trust.desc: A Confederate officer is called off to war. He leaves his wife and daughter in the care of George, his faithful Negro servant. After the officer is killed in battle, George continues in his caring duties, faithful to his trust.

histoires-parallelles.title: Histoires parallèlles
histoires-parallelles.desc: Official visits and their rituals;manipulated black and white found footage of a professional indian reel news with my father's amateur film of the more or less similar type of official events in the french oversea region where I grew up.

natural-history-suite.title: Natural History Suite
natural-history-suite.desc: An eight-part animated portrait of various species, accompanied by a different style of music. The various parts are: Aquatilia (foxtrot), Hexapoda (bolero), Pisces (blues), Reptilia (tarantella), Aves (tango), Mammalia (minuet), Simiae (polka) and Homo (waltz). Each animation mixes drawings, pictures, real animals and animated skeletons.

history-of-a-crime.title: History of a Crime
history-of-a-crime.desc: A convicted criminal dreams about his past the night before his execution.

an-history-of-civilisation.title: An History of Civilisation
an-history-of-civilisation.desc: As families enjoy the May Day sun at a funfair in a south-east London park, overlooked by the skyscrapers of the financial district, Martin Donegan reads philosophical quotes from Mao Tse Tung on the future of society.

history-of-civilization.title: History of Civilization
history-of-civilization.desc: Indira decides to restart her life and move to London. However, on her last day, she dares to explore what she will leave behind.

history-of-the-main-complaint.title: History of the Main Complaint
history-of-the-main-complaint.desc: History of the Main Complaint is the sixth film [of a] series and is based on twenty-one drawings. It was made shortly after the establishment in South Africa of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission, headed by Archbishop Desmond Tutu. It was set up to conduct a series of public hearings into abuses of human rights perpetrated during the apartheid era. The hearings, in which individuals told their stories of personal suffering, were held in order to make reparation for abuse and in the hope of creating reconciliation between peoples. The underlying theme of this film is a (self) recognition of white responsibility. This is played out through a 'medical' investigation into the body of Soho…

the-history-of-the-world-episode-10-the-.title: The History of the World Episode 10: The Discovery of Language
the-history-of-the-world-episode-10-the-.desc: An animated short film by Phil Mulloy.

the-history-of-the-world-episode-16-the-.title: The History of the World Episode 16: The Invention of Writing and Its Destruction
the-history-of-the-world-episode-16-the-.desc: Animator Phil Mulloy follows a simple maxim in hypothesizing the origins of writing: the crudest explanation is most likely the correct one.

history-of-the-world-in-three-minutes-fl.title: History of the World in Three Minutes Flat
history-of-the-world-in-three-minutes-fl.desc: A history of life on Earth compressed into three minutes.

historytelling.title: Historytelling
historytelling.desc: A documentary with students from two schools, two cultures, sharing the same territory. At an age when they are still well entrenched in the present moment, children begin learning history and already serve us a lesson.

hitchcocked-2006.title: Hitchcocked
hitchcocked-2006.desc: Al and Fred hook up for a little casual fun that soon turns ugly, revealing some fateful truths about Internet-dating, love and death.

hittin-the-trail-for-hallelujah-land.title: Hittin' the Trail for Hallelujah Land
hittin-the-trail-for-hallelujah-land.desc: Piggy and Fluffy have adventures on a riverboat and Uncle Tom is chased by skeletons promising to take him to Hallelujah Land.

hiv-the-musical.title: HIV: The Musical
hiv-the-musical.desc: James wrote a play. Myles made it gay.

ho-1979.title: HO
ho-1979.desc: An experimental film on Brazilian avant-garde artist Hélio Oiticica and his works, especially the Parangolés.

hoagy-carmichael.title: Hoagy Carmichael
hoagy-carmichael.desc: Short musical subject featuring the work of composer Hoagy Carmichael performed by him and featuring Jack Teagarden and his Orchestra, as well as vocalist Meredith Blake.

hoarders-without-borders.title: Hoarders Without Borders
hoarders-without-borders.desc: Featuring crystallized magic markers and the kidney stone of a horse, the generously-curated mineral collection of Mary Johnson comes to life in a manual labor of love for the process of archival procedure.

the-hoarding.title: The Hoarding
the-hoarding.desc: When Mary starts her first job as a cleaner inside a hoarder's home she finds much more than she bargained for.

j-r-r-tolkiens-the-hobbit.title: J. R. R. Tolkien's The Hobbit
j-r-r-tolkiens-the-hobbit.desc: This short film is the first film adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's 1937 novel, The Hobbit. The film is a considered an "ashcan copy" as it was made quickly and cheaply by the producer to keep the rights to to the material.

hobo-with-a-shotgun-2007.title: Hobo with a Shotgun
hobo-with-a-shotgun-2007.desc: Short mock trailer attached to select Canadian screenings of "Grindhouse."

hoch-der-lambeth-valk.title: Hoch der Lambeth Valk
hoch-der-lambeth-valk.desc: A 1941 Ministry of Information propaganda film set to the tune of The Lambeth Walk, a popular song from the musical Me and My Girl.

the-hockey-champ.title: The Hockey Champ
the-hockey-champ.desc: Donald shows his nephews the moves that won him his hockey trophy. But the boys have a few moves of their own.

hockey-homicide.title: Hockey Homicide
hockey-homicide.desc: A crowd gathers at the skating rink to watch the big championship hockey game of the Pelicans versus the Aardvarks. Although referee "Clean Game" Kinney does his best to supervise, the hockey game really gets out of hand eventually. Two star players, Bertino and Ferguson, are so anxious, they never get let out of the penalty box, referee Kinney is never able to drop the puck without being physically hurt somehow, and the spectators themselves are so worked into the game, they take out their aggression on the ice while the players relax in the bleachers.

hoi-polloi-1990.title: Hoi-Polloi
hoi-polloi-1990.desc: Part home-movie, part diary, evoking the disembodied voices of the hoi polloi, manifest as an animistic presence within the landscape.

hoist.title: Hoist
hoist.desc: Commissioned as part of the Destricted Short Film Series, 'Hoist' was shot in Bahia, Salvador. It's described by the director as "a juxtaposition of sexuality and industrial machinery".

hold-anything.title: Hold Anything
hold-anything.desc: Bosko is a construction worker who impresses Honey by making music from everything in sight, including a decapitated mouse, a typewriter and a goat filled with hot air.

hold-me-2021.title: Hold Me
hold-me-2021.desc: Between friends whose relationship is rather vague. On their graduation day. Instead of confessing his feelings, Yeon-ho attempts to apologize, but Jae-min bravely opens up his heart first. Will Yeon-ho be able to take Jae-min's extended hand?

hold-me-tight-2021.title: Hold Me Tight
hold-me-tight-2021.desc: In the heart of a dark forest, two silhouettes meet, attract and repel each other in an explosive bridal parade. "Hold Me Tight" is a bittersweet romance.

hold-that-pose.title: Hold That Pose
hold-that-pose.desc: Goofy is tired and bored. He needs a hobby and decides to pursue photography. Wildlife is an excellent choice for photography so Goofy decides to take a grizzly bear's picture. Unfortunately, when Goofy's flash powder explodes, the bear becomes infuriated and chases Goofy through an amusement park and back to his apartment. Fortunately for Goofy, the bear is pleased with the resulting pictures and ultimately sets up a stand giving his "autographed photo" for $10.

hold-the-lion-please-1942.title: Hold the Lion, Please
hold-the-lion-please-1942.desc: A lion wants to prove he's still "King of the Jungle" and, to prove it, he hunts rabbit.

holding-your-breath.title: Holding Your Breath
holding-your-breath.desc: A child explores her changing relationships with friends in an industrial town.

hole-1992.title: Hole
hole-1992.desc: In Hole, the subject matter is a man made hole near a construction site. Employing static camera shots and conventional compositions, the film is an exploration of light, but also of scale as the filmmaker contrasts the human and feline appearances that pass through the hole

hole-2014.title: Hole
hole-2014.desc: A disabled man yearns for intimacy in a world that would rather ignore him.

the-hole-idea.title: The Hole Idea
the-hole-idea.desc: A scientist invents the portable hole, only to have a thief steal his samples to go on a crime spree.

the-hole-1962.title: The Hole
the-hole-1962.desc: Two men discuss the nature of accidents and the possibility of nuclear war.

holiday-1975.title: Holiday
holiday-1975.desc: Film unfolds in five sequences, each depicting a facet of Barbórka celebrations—from the miners’ orchestra wake-up call and the medal-awarding academy through evening feasting and dancing. Folk traditions mingle with party-state rituals as speeches for the PZPR Congress intercut candlelit toasts. In the opening mining-orchestra segment, dynamic editing syncs shot length to the music’s tempo, while grotesque staging casts engineers as conductors and workers’ movements as instrumental solos.

holiday-fear.title: Holiday Fear
holiday-fear.desc: In the final act of a slasher film, Bruce attempts to reclaim his manliness and impress the final girl by finishing off the killer.

holiday-film.title: Holiday Film
holiday-film.desc: A woman on a meadow, strolling around, narcisstically involved, wandering. Now and again one can see her breasts through her half-opened shirt. The camera films with a powerful telephoto lens. This idyll is radically destroyed when the woman suddenly looks directly into the camera. There is an immediate cut (the voyeur has been discovered) and the whole sequence of events begins from the beginning again, but each time re-filmed from the last till finally, only a completely abstract, flickering picture remains.

holiday-for-shoestrings.title: Holiday for Shoestrings
holiday-for-shoestrings.desc: To the tune of The Nutcracker, a number of elves do all the work in a shoe shop.

holiday-land.title: Holiday Land
holiday-land.desc: Scrappy does not want to get up and go to school. As the days peel off his calendar, the holidays come to life, personified. Father Time takes Scrappy on a tour through Holiday Land.

holidaze-2019.title: Holidaze
holidaze-2019.desc: Jangle is a spirit of Halloween, Jingle is a spirit of Christmas! What happens when they meet and share with each other the fun festive customs of their holidays? Perhaps they have more in common then they expect!

hollyshorts-greeting.title: Hollyshorts Greeting
hollyshorts-greeting.desc: A fun short piece that Lynch presented as his acceptance for the Hollyshorts 2008 Visionary Award.

the-hollywood-bowl.title: The Hollywood Bowl
the-hollywood-bowl.desc: Tom is conducting a symphony at the Hollywood Bowl when Jerry comes out to co-conduct.

hollywood-capers.title: Hollywood Capers
hollywood-capers.desc: W.C.Fields enters the Warmer Bros. Studio. Beans tries to drive in, but the guard throws him and his car against a tree. Charlie Chaplin drives in, followed by Oliver Hardy on foot - but we see that it's really Beans in disguise. Oliver Owl is directing a picture; Beans sneaks onto the stage. He's watching from a catwalk when someone knocks him off, into the middle of the scene. Beans is thrown off the set, right into the set of a Frankenstein movie. He accidentally brings the robotic monster to life, and it crashes into the original studio, eating the camera. Beans tries to stop the monster, but is sent flying. He lands against a wind machine. which chops up the monster.

hollywood-daffy.title: Hollywood Daffy
hollywood-daffy.desc: Daffy sneaks onto the Warmer Brothers lot, eventually posing as a tour guide. Daffy spoofs a number of contemporary stars, and others appear as "themselves". He also has a number of run-ins with a studio cop.

hollywood-handicap.title: Hollywood Handicap
hollywood-handicap.desc: A group of stable hands is given a race horse when its owner retires from the business. They raise money to run the horse in the Hollywood Derby at Santa Anita race track. Many Hollywood personalities attend the event.

hollywood-steps-out.title: Hollywood Steps Out
hollywood-steps-out.desc: A tour of Ciro's Nightclub packed with caricatures of many top stars.

the-hollywood-ten.title: The Hollywood Ten
the-hollywood-ten.desc: A brief look at The Hollywood Ten, a group of screenwriters and directors charged with contempt of court after challenging the House Un-American Activities Committee and their controversial and self-incriminatory questions during the red scare. With that act of defiance, they were sentenced to one year in prison simply for speaking their minds and exercising their constitutional rights as concerned citizens. This is their story, their version of the facts, and their opinions.

holy-cycles.title: HoLy Cycles
holy-cycles.desc: Steadily reading while/becomes treading into murky waters.

holy-moses.title: Holy Moses
holy-moses.desc: In 1963 a cow goes missing from an Irish Magdalene Asylum only to reappear 25 years later at a gas station in Texas. The attendant calls the sheriff, the sheriff calls the doctor, and together the three discover a strange mystery in the middle of an American nowhere.

holy-woods.title: Holy Woods
holy-woods.desc: A young woman watches a man having a nap under the trees, and gets ready to paint. Trees are cut one after another by vigorous loggers. Insects stand motionless or crawl everywhere. All those are interlaced with more fleeting images that anyone could see or not.

homage-to-jean-tinguelys-homage-to-new-y.title: Homage to Jean Tinguely's 'Homage to New York'
homage-to-jean-tinguelys-homage-to-new-y.desc: A record, of sorts, of the birth and death of Tinguely’s famous auto-destructive sculpture. Filmed on the spot at MoMA, this film also exploits a wide range of camera and editing techniques to give it a life of its own, independent of and parallel to the subject. — Anthology Film Archives

homage-to-magritte.title: Homage to Magritte
homage-to-magritte.desc: This film opens with the sense of juxtaposition and absurdity that are the basis of Magritte's paintings, and succeeds in contributing to the surrealist tradition through subtle and powerful manipulations of the filmed image.

homage-to-tarzan.title: Homage to Tarzan
homage-to-tarzan.desc: Avant-garde analog animation techniques in stark black and white dramatize the effect of white men’s violence on an African jungle.

home-1998-1.title: Home
home-1998-1.desc: A local council worker inspects three homes.

home-base.title: Home Base
home-base.desc: A bitter ex-boyfriend exacts sweet revenge by actively pursuing a sexual relationship with his former girlfriend's mother.

home-defense.title: Home Defense
home-defense.desc: Donald is manning a listening post and falls asleep; he blows trumpet calls in his sleep and wakes his nephews. For their revenge, they send up a model airplane filled with gingerbread men with parachutes; Donald shoots it down, and cowers in fear when he sees the parachutes (and hears a simulated battle), until one lands on his beak. Donald kicks his nephews out until he mistakes a bee for an airplane, and calls them back to fight this menace.

the-home-front.title: The Home Front
the-home-front.desc: A homesick Pvt. Snafu learns that his family are almost as committed to the war efforts as himself.

home-in-the-weather.title: Home in the Weather
home-in-the-weather.desc: Shot on 1990s expired Kodak Ektachrome 160A in Nottingham, December 2016.

home-made-home.title: Home Made Home
home-made-home.desc: Goofy's building a house, and struggling with the blueprints, the window glass, the paint, and finally the house-warming guests.

home-movie-1986.title: Home Movie
home-movie-1986.desc: Retrieving a family movie of the 50's bought in a shop of second-hand objects. After being filmed in black and white, the original was decomposed and recomposed by gluing the new black and white support.

home-movie-1974.title: Home Movie
home-movie-1974.desc: Filmmaker Jan Oxenberg narrates her own home videos, commenting on how her views towards lesbianism and femininity have evolved over time.

home-movies-1980.title: Home Movies
home-movies-1980.desc: A compilation of Tony Buba's home movies

home-movies-2017.title: Home Movies
home-movies-2017.desc: In this home movie collection of gay men, memory serves as an act of hope, power, and above all, resilience.

home-on-the-rails.title: Home on the Rails
home-on-the-rails.desc: A couple lives in a house situated on the railway tracks. They lead a peaceful domestic life, despite the periodic interruptions of the train passing through their living room; but when the husband - a gold prospector - falls down on his luck, the train comes to assume a more ominous significance.

home-road-movies.title: Home Road Movies
home-road-movies.desc: A sweet reminiscence about a family of four children and their RAF-veteran dad, who knows the timetable of every bus in London, but realizes his large family needs a car. He buys a Peugeot station wagon - license plate GFP831E, and the family sets off for annual holidays exploring every corner of Europe - "adopting local customs but never forgetting who won the war." The narrator is one of the children who, as he ages, sees things he missed as a lad - the car no rocket, dad no speedster. As the years wear on, and the car sits in the driveway, dad keeps it ready for the next great summer holiday.

home-stories.title: Home Stories
home-stories.desc: This one is a collage of Hollywood melodramas of the 1950s and 1960s, filmed directly from the television set. The constantly recurring motifs of suspense and clichés of plot make it possible to move seamlessly among scenes from different films with different protagonists: uneasy sleep, getting up, listening at the door, turning on the lights, being startled, etc. In the montage, the movements and gestures of the actresses – stars like Lana Turner, Tippi Hedren, and Grace Kelly– seem choreographed and planned for each other. The soundtrack supports this effect with connecting passages of sound that imitate the stereotypes of the genre. The treatment concentrates the dramatic shift from the…

home-sweet-home-2013-2.title: Home Sweet Home
home-sweet-home-2013-2.desc: A house uproots itself from its suburban foundations and sets off on an epic journey.
home-sweet-home-2013-2.director: Pierre Clenet, Alejandro Diaz, Romain Mazevet, Stéphane Paccolat

home-honey-im-high.title: Home, Honey, I'm High!
home-honey-im-high.desc: Pot really hits the spot in this family.

home-tweet-home.title: Home, Tweet Home
home-tweet-home.desc: Tweety Bird is washing in a bird bath in a city park when Sylvester Cat interrupts him. Sylvester chases Tweety, and Tweety takes refuge near a feisty nanny and her toddler. Sylvester dresses as the toddler to try to grab Tweety but is stopped and spanked. Tweety flies to a building ledge, and Sylvester unsuccessfully uses chewing gum to try to reach him. Next, Sylvester angers a bulldog, who chases him away.

home-alone-2015.title: Home/Alone
home-alone-2015.desc: A girl spends a night home alone for the very first time.

the-home-2017.title: The Home
the-home-2017.desc: Set in a small, isolated 19th century Irish home for unwed mothers, a young pregnant woman must fight for her survival as the home falls siege to a group of mysterious invaders.

homecoming-2013.title: Homecoming
homecoming-2013.desc: Kenyan Jim Chuchu’s short film casts a voyeur’s obsession with the girl next door, blurring the lines between fantasy and reality, science fiction and fiction.

homecoming-2018.title: Homecoming
homecoming-2018.desc: A man babysits his girlfriends kid, and after a short while screams come from her room. Apparently she believes there's a monster under her bed.

the-homeless-flea.title: The Homeless Flea
the-homeless-flea.desc: A flea sets up its new home in the fur of a sleeping dog.

homeless-hare.title: Homeless Hare
homeless-hare.desc: A construction worker destroys Bugs' home with a steam shovel and refuses to repair the damage.

homeless-home.title: Homeless Home
homeless-home.desc: "No one can escape their roots, however rotten they may be"

homer_b.title: homer_b
homer_b.desc: From some of Winnipeg’s weirdest minds comes a nightmarish vision that seems to have leaked out from the darkest recesses of Matt Groening’s subconscious and then been somehow preserved on the world’s last VHS cassette. Just who is this clown behind the microphone stand and what does he want?

homesick-2022.title: Homesick
homesick-2022.desc: "Homesick" is an absurdist thriller about an unhappy man who attends a retreat offering adults a second chance at a happy childhood.

homesteader-droopy.title: Homesteader Droopy
homesteader-droopy.desc: Droopy and family head west to start a new homestead, but have to defend it against Dishonest Dan the cattle man.

honey-harvester.title: Honey Harvester
honey-harvester.desc: Donald is working in his greenhouse when he notices a bee harvesting nectar (well, actually, it appears to already be honey). Donald tries various approaches to find the hive, which despite the bee's best efforts to throw him off, he eventually discovers in the radiator of an old car. He drains the honey and starts to leave when the bee spots him and mounts an attack. The bee adds a cactus needle to extend his stinger. Donald relents and returns the honey all but one jar, until the bee spots him.

honey-moon.title: Honey Moon
honey-moon.desc: A touching portrait of his partner Akiko and the days following their wedding, Iimura's conceptual rigour loosens in favour of intimacy in Honey Moon. (Julian Ross)

honeys-money.title: Honey's Money
honeys-money.desc: Yosemite Sam marries a wealthy widow for her money.

the-honey-mousers.title: The Honey-Mousers
the-honey-mousers.desc: In this spoof of TV's "The Honeymooners", Ralph Crumden and Ned Morton are mouse versions of Jackie Gleason and Art Carney's characters on the TV show. When new human tenants move into the apartment where the Crumden and Morton couples live, Ralph and Ned try to gain access to a banquet of food in the people's refrigerator, which is guarded by an orange cat.

honeymoon-hotel-1934.title: Honeymoon Hotel
honeymoon-hotel-1934.desc: After introducing the small town of Bugtown, inhabitated by bugs, this short shows what happens to two honeymooning lovebugs at the Honeymoon Hotel, due to the fact that their love is a little bit too hot.

honeymoon-in-reno.title: Honeymoon in Reno
honeymoon-in-reno.desc: I was hoping to strike it rich on our honeymoon in Reno. In a way I did, seeing that the camera was filled with very rich imagery in recording this visual journal of our brief visit. The soundtrack is a creation of Katie Steinorth who translated the Buddhist chant of “Om Ma Ni Pad Me Hum” into the words “Oh, Money Bring Me A Home.” —Canyon Cinema

hong-sangsoo-winner-of-the-silver-bear-f.title: Hong Sangsoo – Winner of the Silver Bear for Best Screenplay
hong-sangsoo-winner-of-the-silver-bear-f.desc: A short film about the award ceremony at Berlinale '21 and then also about a snail.

the-honky-problem.title: The Honky Problem
the-honky-problem.desc: A Texas honky tonk concert reveals a major problem.

hook-line-and-stinker.title: Hook, Line and Stinker
hook-line-and-stinker.desc: Wile E. Coyote hopes to catch the Road Runner using a mallet, a cooking pan, a TNT stick, a balloon, and a piano dropped from a precipice. The last of these results in Wile E. falling to the road below along with the piano and ending up with 88 teeth.

hook-lion-and-sinker.title: Hook, Lion and Sinker
hook-lion-and-sinker.desc: A mangy Mountain Lion and his cub try to scrounge Donald's good looking catch of fish.

hooked-bear.title: Hooked Bear
hooked-bear.desc: Humphrey the bear isn't having much luck with his fishing; every time he catches some nice fish, he gets distracted and drops them. So he goes after the catches of the local anglers instead. But ranger Woodlore frowns on this, insisting the bear fish like one.

hooker-on-campus.title: Hooker on Campus
hooker-on-campus.desc: A prostitute plies her wares on a college campus.

hopalong-casualty.title: Hopalong Casualty
hopalong-casualty.desc: Wile E. Coyote tries to catch the Road Runner using a dynamite stick on a fishing pole, a Christmas present wrapping machine, and ACME Earthquake pills.

hope-this-goes-over-well-living-in-an-em.title: Hope This Goes Over Well/Living in an Empty World
hope-this-goes-over-well-living-in-an-em.desc: I really hope this is well-received. I really hope there's some sort of reprieve.

hoppity-pop.title: Hoppity Pop
hoppity-pop.desc: An animated film in which colored shapes dance to calliope music. The visuals were drawn by Norman McLaren directly upon the film with pen and ink. Simple forms dance about the screen to the discordant strains of an old-time circus calliope.

hoppy-daze.title: Hoppy Daze
hoppy-daze.desc: A pudgy but tough-guy cat recruits Sylvester as his stooge to catch a mouse for his dinner, under the pretense of training Sylvester to be a champion mouser. Sylvester enters a warehouse and runs into the baby kangaroo, Hippety Hopper, and thinks, as usual, that Hippety is a giant mouse that must be fought.

horn-dog.title: Horn Dog
horn-dog.desc: A plucky canine fends off an obese dog, attacking oysters, and a wayward killer violin bow, while trying to win the love of his heart's desire.

the-hornbacker-murphy-fight.title: The Hornbacker-Murphy Fight
the-hornbacker-murphy-fight.desc: A referee and five fans (including a waiter in his apron) look on as two young men box. The dark-haired, slightly taller boxer throws a right and the light-haired smaller one goes down; but he's up before the referee starts counting. After the knockdown, the boxers mostly hit each other's gloves. The fans, at least one of whom is sitting inside the ring, show no animation. They're all men, dressed in a range of late 19th-century garb.

horoscope.title: Horoscope
horoscope.desc: Holly Adams plays an attractive but rather repressed young woman. She checks her horoscope, shambles homeward from her dull office job and promptly falls asleep in front of the TV. Two naked young men appear in her living room and begin dancing around for her pleasure.

the-horribly-slow-murderer-with-the-extr.title: The Horribly Slow Murderer with the Extremely Inefficient Weapon
the-horribly-slow-murderer-with-the-extr.desc: From Richard Gale, mad maker of CRITICIZED, comes a film that will never have you looking at cutlery the same way again. Set-up as an epic-length trailer for an upcoming release, HORRIBLY SLOW... depicts a man's endless pursuit by what has got to be one of the most determined and patient murderers the screen has ever seen.

horror-dream.title: Horror Dream
horror-dream.desc: A choreographic interpretation of a dancer's anxiety before starting her theater routine.

hors-doeuvres.title: Hors d'oeuvres
hors-doeuvres.desc: Silent footage of dancers is visually manipulated in a variety of ways.

hors-de-leau.title: Hors de l'eau
hors-de-leau.desc: Through the eyes of a macaque mother, a group of snow monkeys has to face the strict rules which govern their community.
hors-de-leau.director: Simon Duong Van Huyen, Valentin Lucas, Andrei Sitari, Joël Durand, Thibault Leclercq

off-side-1977.title: Off-side
off-side-1977.desc: A descrition of a game between two teams where one of the teams change the rules.

horse-and-rider-jumping-over-an-obstacle.title: Horse and Rider Jumping Over an Obstacle
horse-and-rider-jumping-over-an-obstacle.desc: A horse with rider jumping over an obstacle. A scientific film made for the Prussian army to help their soldiers improve their horseback riding technique.

a-horse-fly-fleas.title: A Horse Fly Fleas
a-horse-fly-fleas.desc: A flea befriends a horsefly, who has hooves like those of a horse, and rides the horsefly into the hair of a dog. The flea chops down strands of the dog's hair to use as "logs" with which to build a cabin, unaware that the dog's coat is the sacred territory of a tribe of Indian fleas, who declare war on the interlopers. The Indians capture and are about to burn the flea and the horsefly when the dog jolts in pain from the fire. The flea and the horsefly free themselves and flee the Indians through the hairs on the dog's carcass.

horse-hare.title: Horse Hare
horse-hare.desc: Yosemite Sam leads his Indians against Fort Lariat while Bugs is in charge.

horse-shoeing.title: Horse Shoeing
horse-shoeing.desc: One of the pictures to be seen in the machine, for example, was that of a blacksmith shop in which two men were working, one shoeing a horse, the other heating iron at the forge. One would be seen to drive the nail into the shoe of the horse's hoof, to change his position and every movement needed in the work was clearly shown as if the object was in real (life). In fact, the whole routine of the two men's labor and their movements for the day was presented to the view of the observer.

horse-trick-riders.title: Horse Trick Riders
horse-trick-riders.desc: In the background is a house. In the foreground, a groom holds the reins of a sleek black horse that stands in profile. A tall man, dressed in a black uniform, demonstrates how to mount the horse then encourages and tries to assist a man in white. The man in white keeps falling, and soon it's apparent that he's an putting on a show. His pratfalls become more elaborate and stylish. The horse stands patient. The little groom laughs to see such sport. And finally, the man in white finds a comic accommodation. The story, though brief, has a beginning, middle, and end.

the-horse.title: The Horse
the-horse.desc: This critically acclaimed 1973 short is about an aristocratic white farming family who has a horse that is being put away, by the father of a young black boy named William. William cares for said horse in its last moments, as the male family members eagerly wait for his dad to arrive.

horses-bathing.title: Horses Bathing
horses-bathing.desc: Mexican vaqueros (cattle herders) in Guadalajara guide their horses through water.

mr-prokouk-a-horseshoe-for-luck.title: Mr. Prokouk: A Horseshoe for Luck
mr-prokouk-a-horseshoe-for-luck.desc: Mr. Prokouk finds a horseshoe and thinks it's a good luck charm. So, he decides to take it with him home and find a suitable place for it. He soon discovers that the horseshoe brings him nothing but bad luck.

horsin-around.title: Horsin' Around
horsin-around.desc: The opening title sequence to the spoof 90s sit-com from BoJack Horseman (2014), released as a stand-alone video on Netflix.

horton-hatches-the-egg.title: Horton Hatches the Egg
horton-hatches-the-egg.desc: Horton the elephant agrees to watch over lazy Maisie bird's egg while she vacations. Much later, after...

hospital-fragment.title: Hospital Fragment
hospital-fragment.desc: An impressionistic series of images inspired by "Tales From the Gimli Hospital".

hostage-2002.title: Hostage
hostage-2002.desc: The Driver is hired by the FBI to help defuse a hostage situation. A disgruntled employee has kidnapped a CEO and has hidden her, demanding $5,088,042. The Driver delivers the money, writing the sum on his hand as instructed by the hostage taker. After he is told that he holds the life of a person in his hand, he is ordered to burn the money. As he complies, the federal agents break in and attempt to subdue the man, who shoots himself in the head before he reveals where the woman is hidden. The Driver then tries to find the hostage before she drowns in the trunk of a sinking car. As a twist, the kidnapped woman is revealed to be the hostage taker's lover. She coldly taunts the dying man in…

the-hot-air-salesman.title: The Hot Air Salesman
the-hot-air-salesman.desc: A door to door salesman visits Betty Boop's home with a long line of useless household gadgets.

hot-air-specialists.title: Hot Air Specialists
hot-air-specialists.desc: A documentation of a Jack Smith drag performance featuring a large red wig.

hot-and-tasty.title: Hot and Tasty
hot-and-tasty.desc: Two drunk friends accidentally walk into a crime scene.

hot-biskits.title: Hot Biskits
hot-biskits.desc: A one-reel comedy short in which a rivalry between two men is played out in a high-stakes game of mini golf.

the-hot-choc-late-soldiers.title: The Hot Choc-late Soldiers
the-hot-choc-late-soldiers.desc: A group of confectionary soldiers go to war against a neighboring cookie castle.

hot-cross-bunny.title: Hot Cross Bunny
hot-cross-bunny.desc: At Eureka Experimental Hospital, a doctor plans to switch the characteristics of a chicken into the brain and a rabbit, into each other. Bugs Bunny was registered as the experimental rabbit, Number 46.

hot-dog-2008.title: Hot Dog
hot-dog-2008.desc: The plucky hero joins a fire company to save the world and gain the affection he so richly deserves. However, the results never turn out the way he plans.

hot-dog-hands.title: Hot Dog Hands
hot-dog-hands.desc: A girl who keeps growing extra fingers lives as a recluse due to bullying. When she sees a possible solution to her condition, it takes her on a path to a much different outcome.

hot-leatherette.title: Hot Leatherette
hot-leatherette.desc: A kinetic film sketch designed to involve the viewers muscles. The rocky seaside cliffs near Stinson Beach, California, hold the wrecked carcass of a #52 pickup that is a rusting monument to Hot Leatherette. Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in 2005.

hot-stuff-1971.title: Hot Stuff
hot-stuff-1971.desc: This tongue-in-cheek cautionary tale by Croatian director Zlatko Grgic traces man's checkered history with fire, and shows how growing carelessness in the form of overloaded sockets, smoldering cigarettes and other fire hazards can have highly undesirable consequences.

hot-rod-and-reel.title: Hot-Rod and Reel!
hot-rod-and-reel.desc: Wile E. Coyote's failed efforts to catch the Road Runner involve the use of roller skates, a gun in a camera, a trampoline, a dynamite stick on a crossbow, a bogus railroad crossing, and a jet-powered unicycle.

hotel-22.title: Hotel 22
hotel-22.desc: Each night in Silicon Valley, the Line 22 transforms from a public city bus into an unofficial shelter for the homeless in one of the richest parts of the world.

hotel-cartograph.title: Hotel Cartograph
hotel-cartograph.desc: The movements across the 2-dimensional space, and in and out of elevators through 3-dimensional space, suggest a conceptual map of the visible environment, which is perhaps drawn by the camera itself. Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in 2010.

hotel-diaries-b-b.title: Hotel Diaries: B & B
hotel-diaries-b-b.desc: The perception of an Anglo-American hotel room is coloured by new revelations about ‘The War on Terror’ and ‘The Special Relationship’ that exists between Britain and the USA.

hotel-diaries-dirty-pictures.title: Hotel Diaries: Dirty Pictures
hotel-diaries-dirty-pictures.desc: Moving from one hotel in Bethlehem to another in East Jerusalem, the filmmaker encounters a series of problems involving a ceiling, a video camera and the Israeli occupation of Palestine.

hotel-diaries-frozen-war.title: Hotel Diaries: Frozen War
hotel-diaries-frozen-war.desc: A disorientating experience while attempting to watch the TV news in an Irish hotel room triggers a spontaneous response to the bombing of Afghanistan.

hotel-diaries-museum-piece.title: Hotel Diaries: Museum Piece
hotel-diaries-museum-piece.desc: While the Iraq war continues, a day’s sightseeing and the features of a German hotel provoke a stream of thoughts about events large and small.

hotel-diaries-six-years-later.title: Hotel Diaries: Six Years Later
hotel-diaries-six-years-later.desc: The filmmaker returns to the city where he made the first video in the series [Frozen War] and looks back at the events of the past six years.

hotel-diaries-throwing-stones.title: Hotel Diaries: Throwing Stones
hotel-diaries-throwing-stones.desc: As the camera looks out through a barred window and the clock strikes four in a Swiss city, the death of Yasser Arafat provides the starting point for a journey back in time.

hotel-magnezit.title: Hotel Magnezit
hotel-magnezit.desc: Documentary about a hostel for workers. An old worker suspected of stealing a motor gets fired from the factory and must leave the hostel.

puppy-2017-1.title: Puppy!
puppy-2017-1.desc: The residents of Hotel Transylvania find their world turned upside-down when youngster Dennis gets a surprise monster-sized pet.

hound-hunters.title: Hound Hunters
hound-hunters.desc: George and Junior get a job as dog catchers and spend the picture trying to catch one measly little dog.

hour-glass.title: Hour Glass
hour-glass.desc: In the midst of the Black consciousness movement, a basketball player imagines his profession to that of a gladiator. After a series of reflections including his upbringing as a foster child of White Americans, he returns to his origins.

an-hour-with-alice.title: An Hour with Alice
an-hour-with-alice.desc: Alice and Paul both study at the Sorbonne University in the Latin Quarter. After a course, Paul, who is attracted to Alice, starts talking with her. They share the same ideas about philosophy and today's philosophers but while they go on with their conversation they realize that as far as cinema is concerned they are not at all on the same wavelength

hours-2015.title: Hours
hours-2015.desc: Darkness has crept in. The hours pass quietly. A window ajar. A shadow observes the moonlight from the window.

the-house-builder-upper.title: The House Builder-Upper
the-house-builder-upper.desc: When Olive Oyl's house burns down, firefighters Popeye and Wimpy decide to build her a new house.

house-cleaning-blues.title: House Cleaning Blues
house-cleaning-blues.desc: Housecleaning blues are just what Betty Boop has the morning after a wild party. Grampy to the rescue!

a-house-divided-1913.title: A House Divided
a-house-divided-1913.desc: A married couple, suspecting one another of infidelity, decide to "live separately together."

the-house-i-live-in-1945.title: The House I Live In
the-house-i-live-in-1945.desc: Frank Sinatra teaches a group of young boys a lesson in religious tolerance.

the-house-in-the-middle.title: The House in the Middle
the-house-in-the-middle.desc: Short film that emphasizes the importance of keeping a tidy home when facing an atomic bomb.

the-bewitched-house-1907.title: The Bewitched House
the-bewitched-house-1907.desc: A group of travellers go into a house for protection. Little do they know, it is filled with ghosts who make unusual things happen to them.

the-house-of-tomorrow.title: The House of Tomorrow
the-house-of-tomorrow.desc: Tex Avery's narrator shows us the amazing features of the ultra-modern House of Tomorrow.

house-specialty.title: House Specialty
house-specialty.desc: Sophie Tatischeff's short film set in the small town of Sainte-Sévère-sur-Indre, three decades after its use in her father's film 'Jour de Fête'. The conversation from a typical village bar is transplanted to a patisserie with particularly tempting tartlets: 'No reason for us not to have another' says one habitué; 'no more for me thanks,' says another. 'A shortbread at this time of day?' asks the woman behind the counter.

the-house-that-drips-blood-on-alex.title: The House That Drips Blood on Alex
the-house-that-drips-blood-on-alex.desc: Tells the tale of Alex as he moves into a peculiar house that mysteriously drips blood on him - a situation that he finds puzzling, perplexing and disturbing.

the-house-that-jack-built-1900.title: The House That Jack Built
the-house-that-jack-built-1900.desc: A cleverly conceived picture of a little boy and girl with building blocks. The little girl has erected a pretty structure, which the boy proceeds to demolish with pokes of his fingers. When the demolition of the house is completed, the film is shown in reverse, and the little building comes back to its original form in a most marvellous manner.

the-house-that-jack-built-1976.title: The House That Jack Built
the-house-that-jack-built-1976.desc: Story about the cow with the crumpled horn that tossed the dog that worried the cat that killed the rat that ate the malt that lay in the house that Jack built.

the-house-that-jack-built-1967.title: The House That Jack Built
the-house-that-jack-built-1967.desc: A humorous animation film about a fellow who builds his house in the best suburb he can afford. He has a picture bride, a picture window and a garden as pretty as a picture, but he wanted something special and, like Jack and the Beanstalk, he finally got it! What he got is a moral for all.

how-a-french-nobleman-got-a-wife-through.title: How a French Nobleman Got a Wife Through the 'New York Herald' Personal Columns
how-a-french-nobleman-got-a-wife-through.desc: A French aristocrat, who has recently arrived in America, has placed a personal advertisement in the newspaper...

how-a-mosquito-operates.title: How a Mosquito Operates
how-a-mosquito-operates.desc: A hungry mosquito spots and follows a man on his way home. The mosquito slips into the room where the man is sleeping, and gets ready for a meal. His first attempts startle the man and wake him up, but the mosquito is very persistent.

how-among-the-frozen-words-she-found-som.title: How Among the Frozen Words She Found Some Odd Ones
how-among-the-frozen-words-she-found-som.desc: Inspired by a chapter in Francois Rabelais' 1653 epic novel "Gargantua & Pantagruel" wherein Pantagruel finds that the explosions, cries and other sounds generated from a battle that had occurred the year before have been frozen into discernable shapes - and that the sounds could be released upon the breaking or melting of the frozen forms.

how-the-cossacks-were-cooking-kulish.title: How the Cossacks Were Cooking Kulish
how-the-cossacks-were-cooking-kulish.desc: Three Cossacks preparing for a meal and gather to smoke their pipes as their meal cooks. Out of tobacco, one of them goes off to investigate smoke on the horizon. He is captured by foreign invaders and must be rescued by his friends.

how-dinosaurs-learned-to-fly.title: How Dinosaurs Learned to Fly
how-dinosaurs-learned-to-fly.desc: The dinosaurs were headed for trouble. They ate nothing but junk food. They never brushed their teeth. They stayed up all night. And though they loved jumping off cliffs, they didn't like the landings much. The early mammals tried to warn them. "Keep that up and you'll all be extinct!" they said. But the dinosaurs just laughed... and over time, they evolved into birds.

how-he-missed-his-train.title: How He Missed His Train
how-he-missed-his-train.desc: A man misses his train due to his clothes turning into other types of clothes.

how-it-feels.title: How It Feels
how-it-feels.desc: Over the past few months, less so now, I've been experiencing some fairly intense spouts of anxiety. Something incredibly new and quite frightening for me. After a bunch of CBT sessions, my therapist recommended channeling my experience into video form. So, here you are. With the help of the incredible Suli Breaks, I've made this little video. Trying to demonstrate how it felt for me. Hope you take something from it.

how-it-feels-to-be-run-over.title: How It Feels to Be Run Over
how-it-feels-to-be-run-over.desc: As the camera looks down an open road, a horse and carriage approaches, and passes by to one side of the field of view. Soon afterwards, an automobile comes up the road, straight towards the camera. As it gets nearer, the occupants start to wave frantically, but can a collision be avoided?

how-men-propose.title: How Men Propose
how-men-propose.desc: Three men in succession propose marriage to Grace Darling; she accepts all! Since they are roommates, the three discover their problem in short order; when they return for an explanation, they're in for a surprise.

how-monsieur-takes-his-bath.title: How Monsieur Takes His Bath
how-monsieur-takes-his-bath.desc: A hapless man tries to get undressed only to find himself magically layered in even more clothes. There is no credited director for this film. Modern attributions go to either Alice Guy or Ferdinand Zecca, according to the PG archives.

how-rastus-got-his-chicken.title: How Rastus Got His Chicken
how-rastus-got-his-chicken.desc: On the day before Thanksgiving, a penniless man named Rastus vows to get a turkey for his family. Desperate, he steals the last available bird from George Green's yard through a fence hole. Unable to pull it through, Rastus breaks off three fence planks and flees, awkwardly carrying both the boards and the bird home to enjoy a festive dinner.

how-rastus-got-his-pork-chop.title: How Rastus Got His Pork Chop
how-rastus-got-his-pork-chop.desc: Farmer Pumpkin's pig won the blue ribbon at an exhibition and visits the photographer's to have his prize pig photographed. The farmer, the photographer give chase to Rastus, who has stolen the pig with the intention of eating it.

how-some-jellyfish-are-born.title: How Some Jellyfish Are Born
how-some-jellyfish-are-born.desc: At a marine biology station, a clump of algae reveals polyps, stomachs with limbs, limbs with buds, buds with poison cells. This animal reproduces by buds, which we watch close up in time-lapse images. In another kind of jellyfish, the buds grow inside then live outside for a few days until being on their own. Another produces eggs, sometimes self-fertilized. Some single eggs become buds with colonies. Another clump gathered at low tide consists of filaments of a colony - plumes with poison ends. In images taking 72 hours, we see filaments grow and produce a feeding organ from which a plume emerges. New jellyfish emerge from buds twice a day at set times to form a new colonies.

how-the-berlin-worker-lives.title: How the Berlin Worker Lives
how-the-berlin-worker-lives.desc: This documentary shows how the Berliner workers lived in 1930. The director Slatan Dudow shows through images: a) the workers leaving the factory; b) the raise of the rents; c) the "unpleasant" guest, meaning the justice officer that brings the eviction notice; d) the fight of classes of the houses of capitalists and working classes; e) the parks of the working class; f) the houses of the working class, origin of the tuberculosis and the victims; g) the playground of the working class; h) the swimming pool for the working class, ironically called the "Baltic Sea" of the working class; i) the effects of humidity of basement where a family lives, with one member deaf; j) one working class…

how-the-cossacks-bought-salt.title: How the Cossacks Bought Salt
how-the-cossacks-bought-salt.desc: Cossacks cooked borscht, but ran out of salt, and what kind of taste without salt? They go to the fair, where they find out that the Chumaks who traded the salt, were robbed by the Evil Pan (local feudal lord). In this series, the Cossacks, fighting off the Evil Pan and his servants, try to bring the stolen salt to the bazaar in order to transfer it to the hands of the rightful owners - the Chumaks.

how-the-hedgehog-and-the-bear-celebrated.title: How The Hedgehog And The Bear Celebrated The New Year
how-the-hedgehog-and-the-bear-celebrated.desc: Teddy Bear comes to the Hedgehog on a visit to together celebrate the New Year. Because of the recent blizzard, the Hedgehog could not get the New Year's tree, so friends quickly went to the forest in search of a green beauty, because before the start of the holiday left very little time. They were looking for a New Year's tree in the forest, but they could not find it. But then the Hedgehog decided to be a tree, because he looks very much like it.

how-the-lion-cub-and-the-turtle-sang-a-s.title: How the Lion Cub and the Turtle Sang a Song
how-the-lion-cub-and-the-turtle-sang-a-s.desc: The Tortoise composed a song and the Lion cub learnt it by heart and they sang it together.

how-they-do-things-on-the-bowery.title: How They Do Things on the Bowery
how-they-do-things-on-the-bowery.desc: Scene Bowery. Young woman drops her handkerchief while passing a Rube. He picks it up and gives it to her. She induces him to go into a side door of a saloon. Second scene, saloon. Rube and woman enter, take seats at table and order drinks. While the Rube is paying for same, woman puts knock-out drops in the Rube's glass. They drink and the Rube falls asleep. Woman takes all his valuables and leaves. Waiter wakes him up. He discovers his watch gone, fights with waiter, and is thrown out. Third scene, outside of saloon. Police patrol drawn up. They put Rube in and drive off.

how-they-get-there.title: How They Get There
how-they-get-there.desc: A guy and a girl play copycat with each other from opposite sides of the street.

how-they-rob-men-in-chicago.title: How They Rob Men in Chicago
how-they-rob-men-in-chicago.desc: A burlesque on the work of highwaymen in Chicago. An elderly gentleman is sandbagged and robbed by a thug, who inadvertently leaves some money on the victim's prostrate body. A policeman shows up.

how-to-be-a-detective.title: How to Be a Detective
how-to-be-a-detective.desc: Goofy is "Johnny Eyeball, Private Eye" who gets mixed up in a surreal whodunnit involving a classy dame, a cop, weasels, and the mysterious missing Al.

how-to-be-a-sailor.title: How to Be a Sailor
how-to-be-a-sailor.desc: Goofy provides a history of ships and sailing.

how-to-be-alone-2019.title: How to Be Alone
how-to-be-alone-2019.desc: When her husband leaves for a night shift, a woman battles physical manifestations of her repressed fears and desires.

how-to-build-a-boat.title: How to Build a Boat
how-to-build-a-boat.desc: A group of Cuban fishermen work along the Cuba-US marine border area (Santa Cruz del Norte-Florida), and are involved with political issues and ongoing illegal migration. Yet they try to continue their normal fishermen life in their country.

how-to-dance.title: How to Dance
how-to-dance.desc: Goofy learns the basics of ballroom dancing.
